# Purpose

This R Markdown file is a **clean revision-analysis workflow** for the Cell Reports Medicine reviewer response. It is deliberately separate from the exploratory MAP Rmd files. It generates the reviewer-requested supplemental figures/tables and the robustness analyses needed for the response letter.

Primary reviewer-response targets:

1. Cohort/sample accounting across modalities.
2. Covariate inventory and Table 1 verification.
3. Distributional and QC visualizations across clinical, immune, metabolite, SCFA/hormone, microbiome, and brain measures.
4. Expanded univariate/sensitivity analyses: primary age/sex model, BMI-adjusted model, and expanded complete-case model when covariate completeness permits.
5. Robust ferutinin analysis for the bimodality/outlier concern.
6. Full volcano plots and representative feature-level plots.
7. Cross-modal correlation diagnostics: full-cohort vs within-CES strata and partial/group-adjusted correlations.
8. sPLS-DA/DIABLO robustness: leakage-aware resampling design, permutation testing, feature stability, and performance confidence intervals.
9. External/orthogonal testing using the probiotic dataset. CES/PBS/PopCS assignment for the external samples uses `Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1` and joins to CalEnviroScreen tract-level scores.

**Important:** Some analyses require the original modality matrices generated by the earlier Rmds. The cleanest way to run this workflow is to export an `analysis_ready_blocks.rds` from the original pipeline after `combined_df_total` and `X.list` are created:

For the full model-robustness sections, first export this from the original MAP Rmd after combined_df_total and X.list exist:
saveRDS(list(phenotype = combined_df_total, blocks = X.list), "analysis_ready_blocks.rds")
Put the official CalEnviroScreen 4.0 results workbook at the path set in the Rmd parameter:
ces_file: "calenviroscreen40resultsdatadictionary_f_2021.xlsx"
For the final heavy run, change:
run_heavy_models: true

# The Rmd includes the external sample analysis using Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1 to assign CES/PBS/PopCS by census tract FIPS.

```r
saveRDS(list(phenotype = combined_df_total, blocks = X.list), "analysis_ready_blocks.rds")
```

If this file is absent, the workflow will still generate analyses from the uploaded phenotype and supplemental files where possible and will write a skip-log listing which raw-matrix-dependent analyses still need the RDS export.

```{r 01_setup, include=FALSE}
skip_log <- tibble(task = character(), reason = character())
add_skip <- function(task, reason) {
  skip_log <<- bind_rows(skip_log, tibble(task = task, reason = reason))
  message("SKIP: ", task, " — ", reason)
  invisible(NULL)
}

save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  path <- file.path(out_dir, "figures", filename)
  ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  path
}

save_table <- function(x, filename) {
  path <- file.path(out_dir, "tables", filename)
  if (inherits(x, "list")) writexl::write_xlsx(x, path) else writexl::write_xlsx(list(data = x), path)
  path
}

safe_read_excel <- function(path, sheet = NULL, ...) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)
  readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, ...)
}

read_excel_allsheets <- function(path) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(path)
  out <- lapply(sheets, function(s) readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = s) |> as.data.frame())
  names(out) <- sheets
  out
}

standardize_id <- function(x) {
  x |> as.character() |> str_trim() |> str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "")
}

as_numeric_clean <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace_all(as.character(x), "[^0-9eE+\\-\\.]", "")))
}

zscore_matrix <- function(x, center = NULL, scale = NULL) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  if (is.null(center)) center <- colMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(scale)) scale <- apply(x, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  scale[is.na(scale) | scale == 0] <- 1
  sweep(sweep(x, 2, center, "-"), 2, scale, "/")
}

make_groups <- function(df, ces_threshold = params$ces_threshold) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      CES_group = case_when(
        !is.na(`CES 4.0 Score`) & `CES 4.0 Score` < ces_threshold ~ "low_CES",
        !is.na(`CES 4.0 Score`) & `CES 4.0 Score` >= ces_threshold ~ "high_CES",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      PBS_group = if ("Pollution Burden Score" %in% names(.)) {
        if_else(`Pollution Burden Score` < median(`Pollution Burden Score`, na.rm = TRUE), "low_PBS", "high_PBS", missing = NA_character_)
      } else NA_character_,
      PopCS_group = if ("Pop. Char. Score" %in% names(.)) {
        if_else(`Pop. Char. Score` < median(`Pop. Char. Score`, na.rm = TRUE), "low_PopCS", "high_PopCS", missing = NA_character_)
      } else NA_character_
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(ends_with("_group"), ~ factor(.x, levels = c("low_CES", "high_CES", "low_PBS", "high_PBS", "low_PopCS", "high_PopCS"))))
}

volcano_plot <- function(res, title, label_n = 10, q_col = "adj.P.Val", p_col = "P.Value", fc_col = "logFC", feature_col = NULL) {
  df <- res
  if (is.null(feature_col)) {
    feature_col <- if ("feature" %in% names(df)) "feature" else if ("Biomarkers" %in% names(df)) "Biomarkers" else names(df)[1]
  }
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      feature_label = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]),
      q_value = .data[[q_col]],
      p_value = .data[[p_col]],
      logFC_value = .data[[fc_col]],
      significance = case_when(
        !is.na(q_value) & q_value < 0.05 & logFC_value > 0 ~ "Up, FDR < 0.05",
        !is.na(q_value) & q_value < 0.05 & logFC_value < 0 ~ "Down, FDR < 0.05",
        TRUE ~ "Not FDR-significant"
      )
    )
  lab <- df %>% arrange(q_value, p_value) %>% slice_head(n = label_n)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC_value, y = -log10(p_value), color = significance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / max(1, nrow(df))), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = feature_label), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Effect estimate / log2 fold change", y = "-log10(P-value)", color = NULL) +
    theme_bw()
}

feature_distribution_plot <- function(mat, meta, features, group_col = "CES_group", title_prefix = "") {
  if (is.null(mat) || nrow(mat) == 0 || length(features) == 0) return(NULL)
  x <- as.data.frame(mat)
  x$sample_id <- rownames(x)
  meta2 <- meta %>% mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum))
  plot_df <- x %>%
    mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(sample_id)) %>%
    select(sample_id, any_of(features)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
    left_join(meta2 %>% select(sample_id, all_of(group_col)), by = "sample_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]), !is.na(value))
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[group_col]], y = value, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.55, size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = title_prefix, x = NULL, y = "Value") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
}

# Align matrix rows to phenotype NDPNum values. Input matrices should have samples as rows.
align_block <- function(mat, meta, id_col = "NDPNum") {
  if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
  if (is.null(rownames(mat)) || any(rownames(mat) == "")) stop("Block matrix must have sample IDs as rownames.")
  mat$.sample_id_std <- standardize_id(rownames(mat))
  meta2 <- meta %>% mutate(.sample_id_std = standardize_id(.data[[id_col]]))
  keep <- intersect(meta2$.sample_id_std, mat$.sample_id_std)
  mat2 <- mat %>% filter(.sample_id_std %in% keep)
  rownames(mat2) <- mat2$.sample_id_std
  mat2$.sample_id_std <- NULL
  as.matrix(mat2)
}
```

```{r load-analysis-ready}
# The original X.list appears to store features x samples. Convert to samples x features.
standardize_blocks <- function(blocks) {
  out <- list()
  for (nm in names(blocks)) {
    x <- blocks[[nm]]
    if (is.null(x)) next
    x <- as.matrix(x)
    # Heuristic: if columns match NDPNum more than rows, transpose to samples x features.
    row_match <- mean(standardize_id(rownames(x)) %in% standardize_id(phenotype$NDPNum), na.rm = TRUE)
    col_match <- mean(standardize_id(colnames(x)) %in% standardize_id(phenotype$NDPNum), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(row_match)) row_match <- 0
    if (is.na(col_match)) col_match <- 0
    if (col_match > row_match) x <- t(x)
    rownames(x) <- standardize_id(rownames(x))
    out[[nm]] <- x
  }
  out
}

blocks <- standardize_blocks(blocks)
block_summary <- tibble(

  n_samples = map_int(blocks, nrow),
  n_features = map_int(blocks, ncol)
)
block_summary
save_table(block_summary, "01_block_summary.xlsx")
```

# CES / PBS / PopCS assignment by census tract FIPS

This section is used for the external probiotic samples. It also creates a reusable function for any future held-out samples with tract FIPS.

```{r ces-fips-functions}
## ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

normalize_fips <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[^0-9]", "")
  # CA tract FIPS = 11 digits, state '06'. Some sources strip the leading 0.
  x <- ifelse(nchar(x) == 10, paste0("0", x), x)
  x <- ifelse(nchar(x) >  11, substr(x, 1, 11), x)
  x <- ifelse(nchar(x) <  10, NA_character_, x)   # anything shorter is unusable
  x
}

find_ces_sheet <- function(path) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(path)
  idx <- which(stringr::str_detect(tolower(sheets),
                                   "ces.*4|final|results"))[1]
  if (is.na(idx)) idx <- 1L
  sheets[idx]
}

## Rename helper that won't error if the source col is missing or duplicated.
.rename_first_match <- function(df, target, pattern) {
  if (target %in% names(df)) return(df)
  hit <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(
    names(df), stringr::regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  hit <- setdiff(hit, target)              # don't rename onto itself
  if (length(hit) >= 1) names(df)[names(df) == hit[1]] <- target
  df
}

load_ces_lookup <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    add_skip(
      "External CES/PBS/PopCS FIPS join",
      paste("CalEnviroScreen file not found at", path,
            "- place the official CalEnviroScreen 4.0 results workbook there",
            "or update params$ces_file."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  sheet <- find_ces_sheet(path)
  ces <- readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, guess_max = 10000) |>
    as.data.frame()

  ## Identify the tract/FIPS column robustly
  tract_candidates <- names(ces)[stringr::str_detect(
    tolower(names(ces)), "census.*tract|tract|fips|geoid")]
  if (length(tract_candidates) == 0)
    stop("Could not find a tract/FIPS column in the CES file.")
  tract_col <- tract_candidates[1]

  ces <- ces |>
    dplyr::mutate(Census_Tract_FIPS = normalize_fips(.data[[tract_col]])) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Census_Tract_FIPS)) |>
    dplyr::distinct(Census_Tract_FIPS, .keep_all = TRUE)   # de-dup defensively

  ## Standardize the score column names used downstream
  ces <- ces |>
    .rename_first_match("CES 4.0 Score",          "CES.*Score") |>
    .rename_first_match("CES 4.0 Percentile",     "CES.*Percentile") |>
    .rename_first_match("Pollution Burden Score", "Pollution.*Burden.*Score") |>
    .rename_first_match("Pop. Char. Score",
                        "Pop.*Char.*Score|Population.*Characteristics.*Score")

  ces
}

assign_ces_by_fips <- function(df, fips_col, ces_lookup,
                               ces_threshold = params$ces_threshold) {
  df2 <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(Census_Tract_FIPS = normalize_fips(.data[[fips_col]]))

  if (is.null(ces_lookup)) return(df2)

  score_cols <- intersect(
    c("Census_Tract_FIPS",
      "CES 4.0 Score", "CES 4.0 Percentile",
      "Pollution Burden", "Pollution Burden Score", "Pollution Burden Pctl",
      "Pop. Char.",     "Pop. Char. Score",        "Pop. Char. Pctl",
      "PM2.5", "PM2.5 Pctl", "Diesel PM", "Diesel PM Pctl",
      "Lead",  "Lead Pctl",
      "Drinking Water", "Drinking Water Pctl",
      "Groundwater Threats", "Groundwater Threats Pctl"),
    names(ces_lookup))

  ces_sub <- dplyr::select(ces_lookup, dplyr::all_of(score_cols))

  joined <- dplyr::left_join(df2, ces_sub, by = "Census_Tract_FIPS")
  make_groups(joined, ces_threshold = ces_threshold)
}

## ---- load ---------------------------------------------------------------

ces_lookup <- load_ces_lookup(input_paths$ces_file)

if (!is.null(ces_lookup)) {
  preview_cols <- c("Census_Tract_FIPS", "CES 4.0 Score",
                    "Pollution Burden Score", "Pop. Char. Score")
  preview <- dplyr::select(ces_lookup, dplyr::any_of(preview_cols)) |>
             head(20)
  save_table(preview, "02_ces_lookup_preview.xlsx")
}
```

# Cohort and sample accounting

```{r sample-accounting}
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
## Cohort and sample accounting (measured vs nominal)
## -------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Block sample counts: padded (nominal) vs measured ----------------
modality_from_blocks <- tibble::tibble(
  modality           = names(blocks),
  n_block_rows       = vapply(blocks, nrow, integer(1)),
  n_features         = vapply(blocks, ncol, integer(1)),
  n_measured         = vapply(names(blocks), function(b) {
    ids <- attr(blocks[[b]], "measured_ids")
    if (is.null(ids)) sum(rowMeans(!is.na(blocks[[b]])) >= 0.10)
    else              length(ids)
  }, integer(1))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_measured = round(100 * n_measured / nrow(phenotype), 1),
    n_padded     = n_block_rows - n_measured
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_measured))

## 2. Phenotype-derived availability proxies (audit; not primary) -----
availability_cols <- names(phenotype)[
  stringr::str_detect(names(phenotype),
                      stringr::regex("MRI|Stool|Blood|PBMC|metagen|cytokine|hormone|RSPW|RSNM|SCFA|AAN|DK|DST|HCP",
                                     ignore_case = TRUE))
]
availability_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  variable      = availability_cols,
  n_non_missing = vapply(availability_cols,
                         function(x) sum(!is.na(phenotype[[x]])),
                         integer(1)),
  n_unique      = vapply(availability_cols,
                         function(x) dplyr::n_distinct(phenotype[[x]],
                                                       na.rm = TRUE),
                         integer(1))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_non_missing = round(100 * n_non_missing / nrow(phenotype), 1)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_non_missing))

## 3. Sample intersection for the key DIABLO model --------------------
key_blocks <- intersect(c("Microbiome", "Brain_RSPW_functional"),
                        names(blocks))

key_model_samples <- if (length(key_blocks) == 2) {
  key_ids <- if (exists("shared_measured_ids")) {
    shared_measured_ids(blocks, key_blocks)
  } else {
    Reduce(intersect, lapply(blocks[key_blocks], function(m) {
      ids <- attr(m, "measured_ids")
      if (is.null(ids)) rownames(m)[rowMeans(!is.na(m)) >= 0.10] else ids
    }))
  }

  phen_key <- phenotype |>
    dplyr::mutate(.sid = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>
    dplyr::filter(.sid %in% key_ids)

  tibble::tibble(
    CES_group = c("low_CES", "high_CES", "unassigned", "total"),
    n         = c(
      sum(phen_key$CES_group == "low_CES",  na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(phen_key$CES_group == "high_CES", na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(is.na(phen_key$CES_group)),
      nrow(phen_key)
    )
  )
} else {
  add_skip("sPLS-DA sample intersection",
           "Microbiome and Brain_RSPW_functional blocks not both available.")
  tibble::tibble(CES_group = character(), n = integer())
}

## -------------------------------------------------------------------
## Helpers for measured vs NA-padded sample bookkeeping in `blocks`
## (Safe to call whether or not annotate_blocks_coverage() was run.)
## -------------------------------------------------------------------

## Null-coalesce, if not already defined elsewhere
if (!exists("%||%")) `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

## IDs of samples actually measured in a single block.
## Uses the `measured_ids` attribute if present; otherwise falls back
## to a row-coverage check.
block_measured_ids <- function(block, min_coverage = 0.10) {
  ids <- attr(block, "measured_ids")
  if (!is.null(ids)) return(ids)
  rownames(block)[rowMeans(!is.na(block)) >= min_coverage]
}

block_padded_ids <- function(block, min_coverage = 0.10) {
  ids <- attr(block, "padded_ids")
  if (!is.null(ids)) return(ids)
  rownames(block)[rowMeans(!is.na(block)) < min_coverage]
}

## Submatrix containing only measured rows; preserves attributes.
measured_subset <- function(block) {
  ids <- block_measured_ids(block)
  out <- block[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  attr(out, "sample_coverage")     <- attr(block, "sample_coverage")
  attr(out, "measured_ids")        <- ids
  attr(out, "padded_ids")          <- character(0)
  attr(out, "min_sample_coverage") <- attr(block, "min_sample_coverage")
  out
}

## Sample IDs measured in ALL of the named blocks.
shared_measured_ids <- function(blocks, block_names) {
  missing <- setdiff(block_names, names(blocks))
  if (length(missing))
    stop("shared_measured_ids: block(s) not found: ",
         paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  Reduce(intersect, lapply(block_names, function(bn)
    block_measured_ids(blocks[[bn]])))
}

## 4. Master cohort waterfall: from cohort to DIABLO model ------------
cohort_waterfall <- tibble::tibble(
  stage = c(
    "Full phenotype cohort",
    "Has a CES group assignment",
    "Has Microbiome measurements",
    "Has Brain_RSPW_functional measurements",
    "Has BOTH Microbiome and Brain_RSPW_functional",
    "Used in DIABLO multi-block model (both + CES label)"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(phenotype),
    sum(!is.na(phenotype$CES_group)),
    if ("Microbiome" %in% names(blocks)) {
      length(attr(blocks$Microbiome, "measured_ids") %||%
             rownames(blocks$Microbiome)[
               rowMeans(!is.na(blocks$Microbiome)) >= 0.10])
    } else NA_integer_,
    if ("Brain_RSPW_functional" %in% names(blocks)) {
      length(attr(blocks$Brain_RSPW_functional, "measured_ids") %||%
             rownames(blocks$Brain_RSPW_functional)[
               rowMeans(!is.na(blocks$Brain_RSPW_functional)) >= 0.10])
    } else NA_integer_,
    if (length(key_blocks) == 2) {
      length(shared_measured_ids(blocks, key_blocks))
    } else NA_integer_,
    sum(key_model_samples$n[key_model_samples$CES_group %in%
                            c("low_CES", "high_CES")], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
## `%||%` from rlang if available, fallback otherwise
if (!exists("%||%")) `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

sample_accounting <- list(
```

```{r covariate-inventory}
# Reviewer-requested covariates and likely phenotype columns.
covariate_patterns <- c(
  age = "^Age$|Age_1$",
  sex = "^Sex$|Demog_Sex",
  bmi = "^BMI$|Body_Mass|Body Mass",
  diet = "Diet|VioScreen|fiber|kcal|calorie|fruit|vegetable|protein|fat|carbohydrate",
  smoking = "smok|tobacco|nicotine",
  alcohol = "alcohol|drink",
  physical_activity = "IPAQ|physical|activity|exercise|MET",
  stress = "stress|PSS|Perceived|ACE|anxiety|BAI|depress|BDI|PROMIS|CDRISC",
  medication = "med|Medication|Antibiotic|PPI|NSAID|SSRI|SNRI|hormone|probiotic",
  socioeconomic = "Income|Education|Marital|Employment|ADI|Poverty|Unemployment|Housing|Linguistic"
)

covariate_inventory <- imap_dfr(covariate_patterns, function(pattern, domain) {
  cols <- names(phenotype)[str_detect(names(phenotype), regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(tibble(domain = domain, variable = NA_character_, n_available = 0, pct_available = 0, n_unique = 0))
  tibble(domain = domain, variable = cols) %>%
    mutate(
      n_available = map_int(variable, ~ sum(!is.na(phenotype[[.x]]))),
      pct_available = round(100 * n_available / nrow(phenotype), 1),
      n_unique = map_int(variable, ~ n_distinct(phenotype[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      proposed_model_use = case_when(
        variable %in% c("Age", "Sex") ~ "primary age/sex model",
        variable == "BMI" ~ "BMI sensitivity model",
        pct_available >= 70 & n_unique > 1 ~ "expanded complete-case candidate",
        TRUE ~ "inventory only / insufficient completeness"
      )
    )
}) %>% arrange(domain, desc(pct_available))

save_table(covariate_inventory, "04_covariate_inventory.xlsx")
covariate_inventory %>% group_by(domain) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r table1-verification}
# Use arsenal if available for a formal Table 1; otherwise produce a compact manual table.
core_table1_vars <- intersect(c(
  "Age", "Sex", "BMI", "median_household_income", "median_home_value",
  "CES 4.0 Score", "Pollution Burden Score", "Pop. Char. Score", "PM2.5", "Diesel PM",
  "Lead", "Groundwater Threats", "Poverty", "Unemployment", "Housing Burden", "Linguistic Isolation"
), names(phenotype))

table1_manual <- map_dfr(core_table1_vars, function(v) {
  x <- phenotype[[v]]
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
  low  <- phenotype |> dplyr::filter(CES_group == "low_CES")  |> dplyr::pull(dplyr::all_of(v))
  high <- phenotype |> dplyr::filter(CES_group == "high_CES") |> dplyr::pull(dplyr::all_of(v))
  low  <- low[!is.na(low)]; high <- high[!is.na(high)]
  p <- if (length(low) >= 3 && length(high) >= 3) {
    tryCatch(stats::wilcox.test(low, high)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else NA_real_
  smd <- if (length(low) >= 3 && length(high) >= 3) {
    pooled_sd <- sqrt(((length(low) - 1) * stats::var(low) +
                       (length(high) - 1) * stats::var(high)) /
                      (length(low) + length(high) - 2))
    if (is.finite(pooled_sd) && pooled_sd > 0)
      (mean(high) - mean(low)) / pooled_sd else NA_real_
  } else NA_real_
  tibble::tibble(
    variable = v, type = "numeric",
    n_low    = length(low), n_high = length(high),
    all      = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
                       stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                       stats::quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                       stats::quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    low_CES  = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
                       stats::median(low,  na.rm = TRUE),
                       stats::quantile(low,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                       stats::quantile(low,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    high_CES = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
                       stats::median(high, na.rm = TRUE),
                       stats::quantile(high, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                       stats::quantile(high, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    p_value  = p,
    effect   = smd,
    effect_type = "SMD"
  )
} else {
  tab <- table(phenotype$CES_group, x, useNA = "no")
  ## Cramér's V
  cv <- tryCatch({
    chi <- suppressWarnings(stats::chisq.test(tab))
    sqrt(chi$statistic / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1)))
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  p <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(stats::chisq.test(tab)$p.value),
                error = function(e) NA_real_)
  ## Format counts as "lvl1: n; lvl2: n; ..."
  counts <- table(x, useNA = "ifany")
  counts_str <- paste(sprintf("%s: %d",
                              ifelse(is.na(names(counts)), "NA", names(counts)),
                              as.integer(counts)),
                      collapse = "; ")
  tibble::tibble(
    variable = v, type = "categorical",
    n_low    = sum(phenotype$CES_group == "low_CES"  & !is.na(x)),
    n_high   = sum(phenotype$CES_group == "high_CES" & !is.na(x)),
    all      = counts_str,
    low_CES  = NA_character_, high_CES = NA_character_,
    p_value  = p, effect = unname(cv), effect_type = "Cramer's V"
  )
}
}) %>% mutate(p_value_fmt = scales::pvalue(p_value))

save_table(table1_manual, "05_table1_verification_manual.xlsx")
table1_manual
```

# Distributional transparency plots from available blocks

```{r block-distribution-qc}
plot_top_variable_distributions <- function(block_name, n_features = 12,
                                            group_col = "CES_group") {
  if (!block_name %in% names(blocks)) {
    add_skip(paste("Distribution plots for", block_name), "Block unavailable.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  ## Restrict to measured rows so we don't visualize NA-padded ghosts
  mat <- blocks[[block_name]]
  measured_ids <- attr(mat, "measured_ids")
  if (is.null(measured_ids))
    measured_ids <- rownames(mat)[rowMeans(!is.na(mat)) >= 0.10]
  mat <- mat[measured_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(mat) < 10) {
    add_skip(paste("Distribution plots for", block_name),
             sprintf("Only %d measured samples; skipping.", nrow(mat)))
    return(NULL)
  }

  feature_var  <- apply(mat, 2, stats::var, na.rm = TRUE)
  feature_var  <- feature_var[is.finite(feature_var) & feature_var > 0]
  if (!length(feature_var)) {
    add_skip(paste("Distribution plots for", block_name),
             "All features had zero variance among measured samples.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  top_features <- names(sort(feature_var, decreasing = TRUE))[
    seq_len(min(n_features, length(feature_var)))
  ]

  p <- feature_distribution_plot(
    mat, phenotype, top_features,
    group_col    = group_col,
    title_prefix = sprintf("%s (n=%d measured samples)",
                           block_name, nrow(mat))
  )
  if (!is.null(p))
    save_plot(p, paste0("S_distribution_", block_name, ".png"),
              width = 10, height = 7)
  p
}
```

# Microbiome composition overview

```{r microbiome-composition-overview, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
## ---- shared regex for host removal -------------------------------------
HOST_TAXA_REGEX <- "homo[ _]?sapiens"   # matches Homo sapiens / Homo_sapiens, any prefix

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_microbiome_composition_plot <- function(micro_mat, meta, top_n = 20,
                                             group_col   = "CES_group",
                                             exclude_taxa = HOST_TAXA_REGEX) {
  if (is.null(micro_mat)) return(NULL)
  mat <- as.data.frame(micro_mat)
  mat$sample_id <- rownames(mat)

  long <- mat %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(value = pmax(as.numeric(value), 0)) %>%
    filter(!stringr::str_detect(tolower(taxon), exclude_taxa)) %>%   # <- drop host
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    mutate(rel_abundance = value / sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  top_taxa <- long %>% group_by(taxon) %>%
    summarise(mean_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abundance)) %>% slice_head(n = top_n) %>% pull(taxon)

  meta2 <- meta %>% mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) %>%
    select(sample_id, all_of(group_col))

  long2 <- long %>%
    mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(sample_id),
           taxon_plot = if_else(taxon %in% top_taxa, taxon, "Other")) %>%
    left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]], sample_id, taxon_plot) %>%
    summarise(rel_abundance = sum(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]))

  ggplot(long2, aes(x = sample_id, y = rel_abundance, fill = taxon_plot)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    facet_grid(.data[[group_col]] ~ ., scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste("Microbiome composition overview: top", top_n,
                       "taxa"),
         x = "Sample", y = "Relative abundance", fill = "Taxon") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right")
}

if ("Microbiome" %in% names(blocks)) {
  p_micro_comp <- make_microbiome_composition_plot(blocks$Microbiome, phenotype, top_n = 20)
  save_plot(p_micro_comp, "S_microbiome_composition_top20.png", width = 12, height = 7)
  p_micro_comp
} else {
  add_skip("Microbiome composition plot",
           "Microbiome block unavailable.")
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_microbiome_composition_plot_side <- function(micro_mat, meta, top_n = 20,
                                                  group_col   = "CES_group",
                                                  exclude_taxa = HOST_TAXA_REGEX) {
  if (is.null(micro_mat)) return(NULL)

  mat <- as.data.frame(micro_mat)
  mat$sample_id <- rownames(mat)

  long <- mat |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(value = pmax(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value)), 0, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(tolower(taxon), exclude_taxa))   # <- drop host

  keep_ids <- long |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(total > 0) |>
    dplyr::pull(sample_id)

  long <- long |>
    dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% keep_ids) |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
    dplyr::mutate(rel_abundance = value / sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  top_taxa <- long |>
    dplyr::group_by(taxon) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_abundance)) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) |>
    dplyr::pull(taxon)

  meta2 <- meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>
    dplyr::select(sample_id, dplyr::all_of(group_col)) |>
    dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  long2 <- long |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id  = standardize_id(sample_id),
                  taxon_plot = dplyr::if_else(taxon %in% top_taxa, taxon, "Other")) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_col]], sample_id, taxon_plot) |>
    dplyr::summarise(rel_abundance = sum(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop")

  ggplot2::ggplot(long2,
                  ggplot2::aes(x = sample_id, y = rel_abundance, fill = taxon_plot)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(stats::reformulate(group_col, response = "."),
                        scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste("Microbiome composition overview: top", top_n,
                                "taxa"),
                  x = "Sample", y = "Relative abundance", fill = "Taxon") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   legend.position = "right",
                   strip.text   = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_microbiome_composition_plot_side_zoom <- function(micro_mat, meta,
                                                       top_n     = 20,
                                                       group_col = "CES_group",
                                                       exclude_taxa = HOST_TAXA_REGEX) {
  if (is.null(micro_mat)) return(NULL)

  mat <- as.data.frame(micro_mat)
  mat$sample_id <- rownames(mat)

  long <- mat |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "value") |>
    dplyr::mutate(value = pmax(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value)), 0, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(tolower(taxon), exclude_taxa))   # <- drop host

  keep_ids <- long |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(total > 0) |>
    dplyr::pull(sample_id)

  long <- long |>
    dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% keep_ids) |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
    dplyr::mutate(rel_abundance = value / sum(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  top_taxa <- long |>
    dplyr::group_by(taxon) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_abundance)) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) |>
    dplyr::pull(taxon)

  meta2 <- meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>
    dplyr::select(sample_id, dplyr::all_of(group_col)) |>
    dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  long2 <- long |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(sample_id)) |>
    dplyr::filter(taxon %in% top_taxa) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_id) |>
    dplyr::mutate(top_total = sum(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(top_total > 0) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_col]], sample_id, taxon) |>
    dplyr::summarise(rel_abundance = sum(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
                     top_total     = dplyr::first(top_total),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(rel_abundance = rel_abundance / top_total)

  ggplot2::ggplot(long2,
                  ggplot2::aes(x = sample_id, y = rel_abundance, fill = taxon)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 1) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(stats::reformulate(group_col, response = "."),
                        scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1),
                                labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = paste("Microbiome composition (zoomed): top", top_n,
                       "taxa only"),
      subtitle = "Each sample renormalized to its top-N coverage (no 'Other' shown)",
      x = "Sample", y = "Within–top-N relative abundance", fill = "Taxon"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   legend.position = "right",
                   strip.text   = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
}

make_microbiome_composition_plot_side_zoom_top10 <- function(micro_mat, meta,
                                                             group_col = "CES_group") {
  make_microbiome_composition_plot_side_zoom(micro_mat, meta, top_n = 10,

}
```

```{r limma-helpers}
fit_limma_continuous <- function(mat, meta, exposure, covariates = c("Age", "Sex"), id_col = "NDPNum") {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  rownames(mat) <- standardize_id(rownames(mat))
  meta2 <- meta %>% mutate(.sample_id_std = standardize_id(.data[[id_col]]))
  needed <- c(exposure, covariates)
  needed <- needed[needed %in% names(meta2)]
  dat <- meta2 %>% filter(.sample_id_std %in% rownames(mat)) %>% select(.sample_id_std, all_of(needed))
  dat <- dat %>% filter(if_all(all_of(needed), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  mat2 <- mat[dat$.sample_id_std, , drop = FALSE]
  design_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(c(sprintf("`%s`", exposure), covariates[covariates %in% names(dat)]), collapse = " + ")))
  design <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = dat)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(t(mat2), design) |> limma::eBayes()
  coef_name <- colnames(design)[str_detect(colnames(design), fixed(exposure))][1]
  if (is.na(coef_name)) coef_name <- 2
  res <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "P")
  res$feature <- rownames(res)
  res$model_exposure <- exposure
  res$model_covariates <- paste(covariates[covariates %in% names(dat)], collapse = ";")
  res$n <- nrow(dat)
  res
}

fit_limma_binary <- function(mat, meta, group_col = "CES_group", contrast = "high_CES-low_CES", covariates = c("Age", "Sex"), id_col = "NDPNum") {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  rownames(mat) <- standardize_id(rownames(mat))
  meta2 <- meta %>% mutate(.sample_id_std = standardize_id(.data[[id_col]]))
  needed <- c(group_col, covariates)
  needed <- needed[needed %in% names(meta2)]
  dat <- meta2 %>% filter(.sample_id_std %in% rownames(mat)) %>% select(.sample_id_std, all_of(needed))
  dat <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]])) %>% filter(if_all(all_of(setdiff(needed, group_col)), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  dat[[group_col]] <- factor(as.character(dat[[group_col]]), levels = c("low_CES", "high_CES", "low_PBS", "high_PBS", "low_PopCS", "high_PopCS"))
  dat[[group_col]] <- droplevels(dat[[group_col]])
  mat2 <- mat[dat$.sample_id_std, , drop = FALSE]
  design_formula <- as.formula(paste("~ 0 +", group_col, ifelse(length(intersect(covariates, names(dat))) > 0, paste("+", paste(intersect(covariates, names(dat)), collapse = " + ")), "")))
  design <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = dat)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
  contrast_clean <- make.names(str_replace_all(contrast, "-", ".minus."))
  # Explicit contrast based on group levels.
  low_name <- make.names(paste0(group_col, "low_CES"))
  high_name <- make.names(paste0(group_col, "high_CES"))
  if (!all(c(low_name, high_name) %in% colnames(design))) {
    stop("Could not construct CES contrast for ", group_col, ". Design columns: ", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", "))
  }
  contrast_string <- paste0(high_name, " - " , low_name)
  contr <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_string, levels = design)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(t(mat2), design)
  fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contr) |> limma::eBayes()
  res <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = "high_minus_low", n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "P")
  res$feature <- rownames(res)
  res$model_group <- group_col
  res$model_covariates <- paste(covariates[covariates %in% names(dat)], collapse = ";")
  res$n <- nrow(dat)
  res
}
```

```{r run-univariate-model-suite, eval=TRUE}
# Runs only for blocks present in analysis_ready_blocks.rds.

## ============================================================
## Univariate model suite — conflict-safe, formula-safe, NA-padded-row aware
## ============================================================

## ---------- −1. Resolve conflicts ONCE for this chunk -------------------
if (requireNamespace("conflicted", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressMessages({
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("fixed",   "stringr", quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter",  "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("select",  "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("slice",   "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("lag",     "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("rename",  "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("step",    "recipes", quiet = TRUE)
  })
}

## ---------- 0. Helpers --------------------------------------------------
.NA_TOKENS <- c("", " ", ".", "NA", "N/A", "n/a", "#N/A", "#NA",
                "NaN", "null", "NULL", "-", "--")
.as_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)); x[x %in% .NA_TOKENS] <- NA_character_
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
.as_fac <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)); x[x %in% .NA_TOKENS] <- NA_character_
  factor(x)
}
.coerce_covariate <- function(v) {
  if (is.numeric(v) || is.logical(v)) return(as.numeric(v))
  vchr <- trimws(as.character(v)); vchr[vchr %in% .NA_TOKENS] <- NA_character_
  num  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vchr))
  if (sum(!is.na(num)) >= 0.8 * sum(!is.na(vchr)) &&
      length(unique(stats::na.omit(num))) >= 5) return(num)
  factor(vchr)
}
.median_impute_cols <- function(mat) {
  if (!anyNA(mat)) return(mat)
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(mat))) {
    col <- mat[, j]
    if (anyNA(col)) {
      m <- stats::median(col, na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(m)) m <- 0
      col[is.na(col)] <- m; mat[, j] <- col
    }
  }
  mat
}

## Make a name syntactically valid AND unique. Returns a named character map
## old_name -> new_name. We use this for ALL columns we'll touch in formulas.
.safe_names <- function(x) {
  out <- make.names(x, unique = TRUE)
  setNames(out, x)
}

## Align by ID intersection (with raw-id fallback).
.align_block_phen <- function(mat, phenotype, id_col = "NDPNum") {
  if (is.null(mat) || nrow(mat) == 0) return(NULL)
  rn_std <- standardize_id(rownames(mat))
  ph <- phenotype |>
    dplyr::mutate(.sid_std = standardize_id(.data[[id_col]]),
                  .sid_raw = as.character(.data[[id_col]]))
  inter_std <- intersect(rn_std, ph$.sid_std)
  inter_raw <- intersect(as.character(rownames(mat)), ph$.sid_raw)
  if (length(inter_std) >= length(inter_raw)) {
    rownames(mat) <- rn_std; keep <- inter_std; ph$.sid <- ph$.sid_std
  } else {
    keep <- inter_raw; ph$.sid <- ph$.sid_raw
  }
  ph <- ph |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.sid) & .sid != "") |>
    dplyr::distinct(.sid, .keep_all = TRUE)
  keep <- intersect(rownames(mat), ph$.sid)
  list(mat  = mat[keep, , drop = FALSE],
       phen = ph[match(keep, ph$.sid), , drop = FALSE],
       n    = length(keep))
}

.prune_covars <- function(phen, covars) {
  if (length(covars) == 0)
    return(list(keep = character(), dropped = character(), phen = phen))
  keep <- character(); dropped <- character()
  for (cv in covars) {
    if (!cv %in% names(phen)) { dropped <- c(dropped, paste0(cv, ":missing")); next }
    v <- .coerce_covariate(phen[[cv]])
    if (sum(!is.na(v)) < 5) { dropped <- c(dropped, paste0(cv, ":all-NA")); next }
    if (is.factor(v)) v <- droplevels(v)
    nl <- if (is.factor(v)) nlevels(v) else length(unique(stats::na.omit(v)))
    if (nl < 2) { dropped <- c(dropped, paste0(cv, ":constant")); next }
    phen[[cv]] <- v; keep <- c(keep, cv)
  }
  list(keep = keep, dropped = dropped, phen = phen)
}

.fail <- function(block, exposure, model, n, reason) {
  tibble::tibble(block = block, exposure = exposure, model = model,
                 n = n, status = "skipped", reason = reason)
}

## Build a model.matrix-ready phenotype data.frame with safe column names,
## and return both the safe names and the original names for reporting.
.prep_design_data <- function(phen, exposure, covars) {
  cols <- unique(c(exposure, covars))
  map  <- .safe_names(cols)             # original -> safe
  df   <- phen[, cols, drop = FALSE]
  names(df) <- map[names(df)]
  list(df = df,
       exposure_safe = unname(map[exposure]),
       covars_safe   = unname(map[covars]),
       map           = map)
}

## A built-in limma fit that bypasses fit_limma_continuous entirely. We use
## this whenever fit_limma_continuous errors -- guarantees we get a result if
## the data are usable at all.
.limma_continuous_fallback <- function(mat, phen, exposure, covars) {
  if (!requireNamespace("limma", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("limma not installed")
  pd <- .prep_design_data(phen, exposure, covars)
  fml <- stats::as.formula(
    paste0("~ ", paste(c(pd$exposure_safe, pd$covars_safe), collapse = " + "))
  )
  design <- stats::model.matrix(fml, data = pd$df)
  # rows in `mat` must match rows used by design; subset both to common rows
  keep <- rownames(pd$df)[stats::complete.cases(pd$df)]
  if (is.null(keep) || length(keep) == 0) keep <- which(stats::complete.cases(pd$df))
  mat2 <- t(mat)                                           # limma: features x samples
  fit  <- limma::lmFit(mat2, design)
  fit  <- limma::eBayes(fit)
  coef_name <- pd$exposure_safe
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  tibble::tibble(
    feature   = rownames(tt),
    estimate  = tt$logFC,
    t         = tt$t,
    p_value   = tt$P.Value,
    p_adj_BH  = tt$adj.P.Val,
    AveExpr   = tt$AveExpr
  )
}

.limma_binary_fallback <- function(mat, phen, group_col, covars) {
  if (!requireNamespace("limma", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("limma not installed")
  pd <- .prep_design_data(phen, group_col, covars)
  grp <- droplevels(factor(pd$df[[ pd$exposure_safe ]]))
  if (nlevels(grp) < 2) stop("group has <2 levels in prepared data")
  pd$df[[ pd$exposure_safe ]] <- grp
  fml <- stats::as.formula(
    paste0("~ 0 + ", paste(c(pd$exposure_safe, pd$covars_safe), collapse = " + "))
  )
  design <- stats::model.matrix(fml, data = pd$df)
  lv  <- levels(grp)
  c1  <- paste0(pd$exposure_safe, lv[1])
  c2  <- paste0(pd$exposure_safe, lv[2])
  if (!all(c(c1, c2) %in% colnames(design)))
    stop("group level columns missing from design matrix")
  contr <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(c2, " - ", c1),
                                levels = design)
  mat2 <- t(mat)
  fit  <- limma::lmFit(mat2, design)
  fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contr))
  tt   <- limma::topTable(fit2, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  tibble::tibble(
    feature   = rownames(tt),
    estimate  = tt$logFC,
    t         = tt$t,
    p_value   = tt$P.Value,
    p_adj_BH  = tt$adj.P.Val,
    AveExpr   = tt$AveExpr
  )
}

## ---------- 1. Defensive wrappers ---------------------------------------

safe_fit_continuous <- function(mat, phenotype, exposure, covariates,
                                block_name, model_label,
                                feature_na_max      = 0.50,
                                min_sample_coverage = 0.10,
                                min_samples         = 8) {

  al <- .align_block_phen(mat, phenotype)
  if (is.null(al) || al$n < min_samples)
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label,
                 ifelse(is.null(al), 0L, al$n),
                 sprintf("only %d samples shared",
                         if (is.null(al)) 0 else al$n)))

  sample_coverage <- rowMeans(!is.na(al$mat))
  has_data        <- sample_coverage >= min_sample_coverage
  n_padded        <- sum(!has_data)
  al$mat  <- al$mat[has_data, , drop = FALSE]
  al$phen <- al$phen[has_data, , drop = FALSE]
  al$n    <- nrow(al$mat)
  if (al$n < min_samples)
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, al$n,
                 sprintf("only %d samples actually measured (%d NA-padded dropped)",
                         al$n, n_padded)))

  phen <- al$phen
  if (!exposure %in% names(phen))
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, al$n,
                 "exposure column missing"))
  phen[[exposure]] <- .as_num(phen[[exposure]])
  if (sum(!is.na(phen[[exposure]])) < min_samples ||
      length(unique(stats::na.omit(phen[[exposure]]))) < 3)
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, al$n,
                 "exposure has too few non-NA / unique values"))

  pr   <- .prune_covars(phen, covariates); phen <- pr$phen
  use_cols <- c(exposure, pr$keep)
  cc <- stats::complete.cases(phen[, use_cols, drop = FALSE])
  if (sum(cc) < min_samples)
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, sum(cc),
                 sprintf("only %d complete cases", sum(cc))))

  mat_cc  <- al$mat[cc, , drop = FALSE]
  phen_cc <- phen[cc, use_cols, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(phen_cc) <- rownames(mat_cc)

  na_frac    <- colMeans(is.na(mat_cc))
  keep_feat  <- na_frac <= feature_na_max
  dropped_na <- sum(!keep_feat); mat_cc <- mat_cc[, keep_feat, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(mat_cc) < 2)
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, nrow(mat_cc),
                 sprintf("only %d features survive NA cap", ncol(mat_cc))))
  mat_cc <- .median_impute_cols(mat_cc)
  fv <- matrixStats::colVars(as.matrix(mat_cc), na.rm = TRUE)
  kv <- !is.na(fv) & fv > 0; dropped_var <- sum(!kv)
  mat_cc <- mat_cc[, kv, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(mat_cc) < 2)
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, nrow(mat_cc),
                 "fewer than 2 variable features"))

  ## Try fit_limma_continuous first; on error fall back to internal limma fit
  attempt <- function(cv_set) {
    out <- tryCatch(
      fit_limma_continuous(mat_cc, phen_cc, exposure, cv_set),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(out, "error")) {
      out <- tryCatch(
        .limma_continuous_fallback(mat_cc, phen_cc, exposure, cv_set),
        error = function(e2) e2
      )
    }
    out
  }
  cv_try <- pr$keep; out <- attempt(cv_try); attempts <- list()
  while (inherits(out, "error") && length(cv_try) > 0) {
    attempts <- c(attempts, paste0("[", paste(cv_try, collapse = "+"), "]"))
    cv_try <- cv_try[-length(cv_try)]; out <- attempt(cv_try)
  }
  if (inherits(out, "error"))
    return(.fail(block_name, exposure, model_label, nrow(mat_cc),
                 paste("all fits failed:", conditionMessage(out))))

  tibble::as_tibble(out) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      block = block_name, exposure = exposure, model = model_label,
      n = nrow(mat_cc), n_padded_dropped = n_padded,
      n_features = ncol(mat_cc),
      n_features_dropped_na = dropped_na,
      n_features_dropped_var = dropped_var,
      status = "ok",
      covariates_used    = paste(cv_try,        collapse = "+"),
      covariates_dropped = paste(c(pr$dropped,
                                   setdiff(pr$keep, cv_try)), collapse = "; "),
      .before = 1)
}

safe_fit_binary <- function(mat, phenotype, group_col, covariates,
                            block_name, model_label,
                            feature_na_max      = 0.50,
                            min_sample_coverage = 0.10,
                            min_samples_per_arm = 2,
                            min_samples         = 8) {

  al <- .align_block_phen(mat, phenotype)
  if (is.null(al) || al$n < min_samples)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label,
                 ifelse(is.null(al), 0L, al$n),
                 sprintf("only %d samples shared",
                         if (is.null(al)) 0 else al$n)))

  sample_coverage <- rowMeans(!is.na(al$mat))
  has_data        <- sample_coverage >= min_sample_coverage
  n_padded        <- sum(!has_data)
  al$mat  <- al$mat[has_data, , drop = FALSE]
  al$phen <- al$phen[has_data, , drop = FALSE]
  al$n    <- nrow(al$mat)
  if (al$n < min_samples)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, al$n,
                 sprintf("only %d samples actually measured (%d NA-padded dropped)",
                         al$n, n_padded)))

  phen <- al$phen
  if (!group_col %in% names(phen))
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, al$n,
                 "group column missing"))
  phen[[group_col]] <- .as_fac(phen[[group_col]])
  if (nlevels(droplevels(phen[[group_col]])) < 2)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, al$n,
                 "group has <2 non-NA levels"))
  tab <- table(phen[[group_col]], useNA = "no")
  if (min(tab) < min_samples_per_arm)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, al$n,
                 paste("smallest arm n =", min(tab))))

  pr <- .prune_covars(phen, covariates); phen <- pr$phen
  use_cols <- c(group_col, pr$keep)
  cc <- stats::complete.cases(phen[, use_cols, drop = FALSE])
  if (sum(cc) < min_samples)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, sum(cc),
                 sprintf("only %d complete cases", sum(cc))))
  mat_cc <- al$mat[cc, , drop = FALSE]
  phen_cc <- phen[cc, use_cols, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(phen_cc) <- rownames(mat_cc)

  tab2 <- table(phen_cc[[group_col]], useNA = "no")
  if (min(tab2) < min_samples_per_arm)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, sum(cc),
                 paste("smallest arm after CC filter:", min(tab2))))

  na_frac <- colMeans(is.na(mat_cc)); kf <- na_frac <= feature_na_max
  dropped_na <- sum(!kf); mat_cc <- mat_cc[, kf, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(mat_cc) < 2)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, nrow(mat_cc),
                 sprintf("only %d features survive NA cap", ncol(mat_cc))))
  mat_cc <- .median_impute_cols(mat_cc)
  fv <- matrixStats::colVars(as.matrix(mat_cc), na.rm = TRUE)
  kv <- !is.na(fv) & fv > 0; dropped_var <- sum(!kv)
  mat_cc <- mat_cc[, kv, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(mat_cc) < 2)
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, nrow(mat_cc),
                 "fewer than 2 variable features"))

  attempt <- function(cv_set) {
    out <- tryCatch(
      fit_limma_binary(mat_cc, phen_cc, group_col, covariates = cv_set),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(out, "error")) {
      out <- tryCatch(
        .limma_binary_fallback(mat_cc, phen_cc, group_col, cv_set),
        error = function(e2) e2
      )
    }
    out
  }
  cv_try <- pr$keep; out <- attempt(cv_try); attempts <- list()
  while (inherits(out, "error") && length(cv_try) > 0) {
    attempts <- c(attempts, paste0("[", paste(cv_try, collapse = "+"), "]"))
    cv_try <- cv_try[-length(cv_try)]; out <- attempt(cv_try)
  }
  if (inherits(out, "error"))
    return(.fail(block_name, group_col, model_label, nrow(mat_cc),
                 paste("all fits failed:", conditionMessage(out))))

  tibble::as_tibble(out) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      block = block_name, exposure = group_col, model = model_label,
      n = nrow(mat_cc), n_padded_dropped = n_padded,
      n_features = ncol(mat_cc),
      n_features_dropped_na = dropped_na,
      n_features_dropped_var = dropped_var,
      status = "ok",
      covariates_used    = paste(cv_try,        collapse = "+"),
      covariates_dropped = paste(c(pr$dropped,
                                   setdiff(pr$keep, cv_try)), collapse = "; "),
      .before = 1)
}

## ---------- 2. Run the suite -------------------------------------------
if (length(blocks) > 0) {

  if (!requireNamespace("matrixStats", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("matrixStats")
  if (!requireNamespace("limma", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("limma", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)

  primary_covars  <- c("Age", "Sex")
  bmi_covars      <- c("Age", "Sex", "BMI")
  expanded_candidates <- covariate_inventory |>
    dplyr::filter(proposed_model_use == "expanded complete-case candidate") |>
    dplyr::pull(variable) |> unique()
  expanded_covars <- unique(c("Age", "Sex", "BMI",
                              utils::head(expanded_candidates, 8)))

  align_overview <- tibble::tibble(
    block = names(blocks),
    n_block_rows       = vapply(blocks, nrow, integer(1)),
    n_features         = vapply(blocks, ncol, integer(1)),
    n_shared_with_phen = vapply(names(blocks), function(b) {
      al <- .align_block_phen(blocks[[b]], phenotype); if (is.null(al)) 0L else al$n
    }, integer(1)),
    n_actually_measured = vapply(names(blocks), function(b) {
      al <- .align_block_phen(blocks[[b]], phenotype)
      if (is.null(al)) return(0L)
      sum(rowMeans(!is.na(al$mat)) >= 0.10)
    }, integer(1))
  )
  message("[model suite] sample overlap by block:")
  print(as.data.frame(align_overview))

  results_list  <- list(); failures_list <- list()
  .stash <- function(res, key) {
    if ("status" %in% names(res) && all(res$status == "skipped"))
      failures_list[[key]] <<- res else results_list[[key]] <<- res
  }

  exposures_cont <- intersect(c("CES 4.0 Score", "Pollution Burden Score",
                                "Pop. Char. Score"), names(phenotype))

  for (bn in names(blocks)) {
    mat <- blocks[[bn]]
    for (exposure in exposures_cont) {
      .stash(safe_fit_continuous(mat, phenotype, exposure, primary_covars,  bn, "primary"),
             paste(bn, exposure, "primary",  sep = "__"))
      .stash(safe_fit_continuous(mat, phenotype, exposure, bmi_covars,      bn, "BMI"),
             paste(bn, exposure, "BMI",      sep = "__"))
      .stash(safe_fit_continuous(mat, phenotype, exposure, expanded_covars, bn, "expanded"),
             paste(bn, exposure, "expanded", sep = "__"))
    }
    .stash(safe_fit_binary(mat, phenotype, "CES_group", primary_covars, bn, "primary"),
           paste(bn, "CES_group", "primary", sep = "__"))
    .stash(safe_fit_binary(mat, phenotype, "CES_group", bmi_covars,     bn, "BMI"),
           paste(bn, "CES_group", "BMI", sep = "__"))
  }

  results_long  <- if (length(results_list))  dplyr::bind_rows(results_list,  .id = "run_id") else tibble::tibble()
  failures_long <- if (length(failures_list)) dplyr::bind_rows(failures_list, .id = "run_id") else tibble::tibble()

  message(sprintf("[model suite] %d runs OK, %d skipped/failed",
                  length(results_list), length(failures_list)))

  if (nrow(failures_long)) {
    cat("\n--- Top failure reasons ---\n")
    print(as.data.frame(failures_long |> dplyr::count(reason, sort = TRUE) |> utils::head(10)))
  }

  save_table(
    list(
      results_long    = results_long,
      failures_long   = failures_long,
      align_overview  = align_overview,
      runs_index      = tibble::tibble(
        run_id = c(names(results_list), names(failures_list)),
        status = c(rep("ok",      length(results_list)),
                   rep("skipped", length(failures_list)))
      )
    ),
    "06_univariate_model_suite_results.xlsx"
  )

} else {
  add_skip("Univariate model suite", "No raw modality blocks available.")
}

#############################################
#############################################

## ============================================================
## Annotate `blocks` with per-sample measurement coverage
## ============================================================

.compute_block_coverage <- function(mat,
                                    min_sample_coverage = 0.10) {
  if (is.null(mat) || nrow(mat) == 0) {
    return(list(
      coverage = tibble::tibble(sample_id = character(),
                                coverage  = numeric(),
                                measured  = logical()),
      measured_ids = character(),
      padded_ids   = character(),
      min_sample_coverage = min_sample_coverage
    ))
  }
  cov <- rowMeans(!is.na(mat))
  ids <- rownames(mat)
  measured <- cov >= min_sample_coverage
  list(
    coverage = tibble::tibble(sample_id = ids,
                              coverage  = unname(cov),
                              measured  = unname(measured)),
    measured_ids        = ids[measured],
    padded_ids          = ids[!measured],
    min_sample_coverage = min_sample_coverage
  )
}

annotate_blocks_coverage <- function(blocks,
                                     min_sample_coverage = 0.10,
                                     verbose = TRUE) {
  if (length(blocks) == 0) return(blocks)

  per_block <- vector("list", length(blocks))
  names(per_block) <- names(blocks)

  for (bn in names(blocks)) {
    info <- .compute_block_coverage(blocks[[bn]], min_sample_coverage)

    ## Attach as attributes on the matrix itself
    attr(blocks[[bn]], "sample_coverage")    <- info$coverage
    attr(blocks[[bn]], "measured_ids")       <- info$measured_ids
    attr(blocks[[bn]], "padded_ids")         <- info$padded_ids
    attr(blocks[[bn]], "min_sample_coverage")<- info$min_sample_coverage

    per_block[[bn]] <- tibble::tibble(
      block               = bn,
      n_rows              = nrow(blocks[[bn]]),
      n_features          = ncol(blocks[[bn]]),
      n_measured          = length(info$measured_ids),
      n_padded            = length(info$padded_ids),
      min_sample_coverage = info$min_sample_coverage
    )
  }

  overview <- dplyr::bind_rows(per_block)

  ## Top-level summaries on the list object too
  attr(blocks, "coverage_overview")    <- overview
  attr(blocks, "min_sample_coverage")  <- min_sample_coverage
  attr(blocks, "coverage_annotated_at") <- Sys.time()

  if (verbose) {
    message("[blocks] coverage annotation written.")
    print(overview)
  }
  invisible(blocks)
}

## ---------- Helper accessors (use these in all downstream chunks) -------

block_measured_ids <- function(block) {
  ids <- attr(block, "measured_ids")
  if (is.null(ids)) {
    cov <- rowMeans(!is.na(block))
    ids <- rownames(block)[cov >= 0.10]
  }
  ids
}

block_padded_ids <- function(block) {
  ids <- attr(block, "padded_ids")
  if (is.null(ids)) {
    cov <- rowMeans(!is.na(block))
    ids <- rownames(block)[cov < 0.10]
  }
  ids
}

## Subset a block to its measured rows only (preserves attributes)
measured_subset <- function(block) {
  ids <- block_measured_ids(block)
  out <- block[ids, , drop = FALSE]
  ## carry forward the relevant attributes
  attr(out, "sample_coverage") <- attr(block, "sample_coverage")
  attr(out, "measured_ids")    <- ids
  attr(out, "padded_ids")      <- character(0)
  attr(out, "min_sample_coverage") <- attr(block, "min_sample_coverage")
  out
}

## Shared sample IDs across a set of block names (measured in ALL of them)
shared_measured_ids <- function(blocks, block_names) {
  ids <- lapply(block_names, function(bn) block_measured_ids(blocks[[bn]]))
  Reduce(intersect, ids)
}

## ---------- Run it once and save an audit file -------------------------

blocks <- annotate_blocks_coverage(blocks, min_sample_coverage = 0.10)

block_coverage_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(blocks), function(bn) {
  cov <- attr(blocks[[bn]], "sample_coverage")
  if (is.null(cov) || nrow(cov) == 0) return(tibble::tibble())
  dplyr::mutate(cov, block = bn, .before = 1)
}))

save_table(
  list(
    coverage_overview   = attr(blocks, "coverage_overview"),
    block_coverage_long = block_coverage_long
  ),
  "04_block_sample_coverage.xlsx"
)
```
