# Robust ferutinin analysis

```{r ferutinin-robustness}
## ============================================================
## Ferutinin robustness — defensively typed regressors
## ============================================================

if (requireNamespace("conflicted", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressMessages({
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("fixed",  "stringr", quiet = TRUE)
  })
}

find_feature <- function(mat, pattern) {
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  cols[stringr::str_detect(cols, stringr::regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))]
}

## Generic regressor sanitization: returns the data.frame plus the list of
## regressors that are actually usable (>=2 non-NA unique values; factors
## with >=2 present levels after droplevels).
.usable_regressors <- function(df, regressors) {
  ok <- character(); reasons <- character()
  for (rg in regressors) {
    v <- df[[rg]]
    if (is.numeric(v) || is.logical(v)) {
      v <- as.numeric(v)
    } else {
      vchr <- trimws(as.character(v))
      vchr[vchr %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", ".", "#N/A", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
      num  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vchr))
      v <- if (sum(!is.na(num)) >= 0.8 * sum(!is.na(vchr)) &&
               length(unique(stats::na.omit(num))) >= 5) num else factor(vchr)
    }
    df[[rg]] <- v
    n_unique <- if (is.factor(v)) nlevels(droplevels(v))
                else length(unique(stats::na.omit(v)))
    if (n_unique < 2) {
      reasons <- c(reasons, sprintf("%s: %d unique level(s)", rg, n_unique))
    } else {
      ok <- c(ok, rg)
    }
  }
  list(df = df, ok = ok, reasons = reasons)
}

.safe_lm <- function(formula, data, label) {
  out <- tryCatch(stats::lm(formula, data = data), error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(out, "error")) {
    warning(sprintf("[ferutinin] %s lm failed: %s", label, conditionMessage(out)))
    return(NULL)
  }
  out
}

.term_row <- function(fit, term) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble::tibble(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  td <- broom::tidy(fit)
  hit <- td[td$term == term, c("estimate", "p.value")]
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) tibble::tibble(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_) else hit
}

run_ferutinin_robustness <- function(mat, meta) {

  feats <- find_feature(mat, "ferutinin")
  if (length(feats) == 0) return(NULL)
  feat <- feats[1]

  ## 1. Build base data, drop NA-padded matrix rows
  sample_coverage <- rowMeans(!is.na(mat))
  ok_rows <- rownames(mat)[sample_coverage >= 0.10]
  mat <- mat[ok_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  dat <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = rownames(mat),
    ferutinin = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mat[, feat]))
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(sample_id)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      meta |>
        dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>
        dplyr::select(sample_id, CES_group, Age, Sex, BMI),
      by = "sample_id"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ferutinin), !is.na(CES_group))

  ## 2. Set up CES_binary AFTER filtering; drop unused levels; require both arms
  dat$CES_binary <- factor(
    as.character(dat$CES_group),
    levels = c("low_CES", "high_CES")
  )
  dat <- dat |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(CES_binary))      # drops any other labels
  if (nlevels(droplevels(dat$CES_binary)) < 2 || nrow(dat) < 10) {
    message(sprintf("[ferutinin] only %d rows or one CES arm present; skipping.",
                    nrow(dat)))
    return(NULL)
  }
  dat$CES_binary <- droplevels(dat$CES_binary)

  ## 3. Sanitize regressors (Age, Sex, BMI)
  reg <- .usable_regressors(dat, c("Age", "Sex", "BMI"))
  dat <- reg$df
  base_covars <- intersect(c("Age", "Sex"),       reg$ok)
  bmi_covars  <- intersect(c("Age", "Sex", "BMI"), reg$ok)
  if (length(reg$reasons))
    message("[ferutinin] dropped covariates: ", paste(reg$reasons, collapse = "; "))

  ## 4. Wilcoxon (non-parametric, robust on its own)
  base_wilcox <- tryCatch(
    stats::wilcox.test(ferutinin ~ CES_binary, data = dat),
    error = function(e) list(p.value = NA_real_)
  )

  ## 5. Adjusted LMs - always include CES_binary plus usable covariates
  build_formula <- function(covars) {
    rhs <- paste(c("CES_binary", covars), collapse = " + ")
    stats::as.formula(paste("ferutinin ~", rhs))
  }
  base_lm  <- .safe_lm(build_formula(base_covars), dat, "base")
  bmi_lm   <- if ("BMI" %in% bmi_covars)
                .safe_lm(build_formula(bmi_covars), dat, "bmi") else NULL

  ## 6. Influence diagnostics on whichever model fit
  robust_lm <- NULL
  if (!is.null(base_lm)) {
    cooks  <- stats::cooks.distance(base_lm)
    cutoff <- stats::quantile(cooks, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    dat$high_influence <- FALSE
    dat$high_influence[as.integer(names(cooks))] <- cooks > cutoff
    robust_dat <- dat |> dplyr::filter(!high_influence)
    ## Re-check regressor levels in the filtered subset
    reg2 <- .usable_regressors(robust_dat, base_covars)
    robust_covars <- intersect(base_covars, reg2$ok)
    if (nlevels(droplevels(robust_dat$CES_binary)) >= 2 &&
        nrow(robust_dat) >= 10) {
      robust_lm <- .safe_lm(build_formula(robust_covars), reg2$df, "robust")
    }
  } else {
    dat$high_influence <- FALSE
  }

  ## 7. Winsorization
  q <- stats::quantile(dat$ferutinin, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  dat$ferutinin_winsor <- pmin(pmax(dat$ferutinin, q[1]), q[2])
  winsor_fml <- stats::as.formula(
    paste("ferutinin_winsor ~", paste(c("CES_binary", base_covars), collapse = " + "))
  )
  winsor_lm <- .safe_lm(winsor_fml, dat, "winsor")

  ## 8. Plot
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(dat,
        ggplot2::aes(x = CES_binary, y = ferutinin, fill = CES_binary)) +
    ggplot2::geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.35) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(ggplot2::aes(shape = high_influence),
                         width = 0.12, alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste("Ferutinin robustness:", feat),
                  x = NULL, y = "Ferutinin value",
                  shape = "High influence") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

  ## 9. Pull effect of CES_binaryhigh_CES from each model
  hi_term <- "CES_binaryhigh_CES"
  base_t   <- .term_row(base_lm,   hi_term)
  bmi_t    <- .term_row(bmi_lm,    hi_term)
  robust_t <- .term_row(robust_lm, hi_term)
  winsor_t <- .term_row(winsor_lm, hi_term)

  nobs_safe <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_integer_ else stats::nobs(x)

  results <- tibble::tibble(
    analysis = c("Wilcoxon", "LM age+sex", "LM age+sex+BMI",
                 "LM remove top 5% Cook's D", "LM winsorized 2.5/97.5%"),
    n        = c(nrow(dat),
                 nobs_safe(base_lm),
                 nobs_safe(bmi_lm),
                 nobs_safe(robust_lm),
                 nobs_safe(winsor_lm)),
    p_value  = c(base_wilcox$p.value,
                 base_t$p.value[1],   bmi_t$p.value[1],
                 robust_t$p.value[1], winsor_t$p.value[1]),
    estimate = c(NA_real_,
                 base_t$estimate[1],  bmi_t$estimate[1],
                 robust_t$estimate[1], winsor_t$estimate[1]),
    covariates = c("-",
                   paste(base_covars,    collapse = "+"),
                   paste(bmi_covars,     collapse = "+"),
                   paste(intersect(base_covars,
                          .usable_regressors(
                            dplyr::filter(dat, !high_influence),
                            base_covars)$ok), collapse = "+"),
                   paste(base_covars,    collapse = "+"))
  )

  list(data = dat, results = results, plot = p, feature = feat)
}

## ---- driver ------------------------------------------------------------
ferutinin_source_blocks <- intersect(
  c("metabolomics_int_stool_01", "metabolomics_int_stool_02",
    "metabolomics_01",           "metabolomics_02"),
  names(blocks)
)

if (length(ferutinin_source_blocks) > 0) {
  fer <- NULL
  for (bn in ferutinin_source_blocks) {
    fer <- tryCatch(
      run_ferutinin_robustness(blocks[[bn]], phenotype),
      error = function(e) {
        message("[ferutinin] block ", bn, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
      }
    )
    if (!is.null(fer)) {
      message("[ferutinin] using block: ", bn,
              "  feature: ", fer$feature,
              "  n: ",       nrow(fer$data))
      break
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(fer)) {
    save_table(list(results = fer$results, plotted_data = fer$data),
               "07_ferutinin_robustness.xlsx")
    save_plot(fer$plot, "S_ferutinin_robustness.png",
              width = 7, height = 6)
    fer$results
  } else {
    add_skip("Ferutinin robustness",
             "No usable ferutinin feature found / contrast not formable in any metabolomics block.")
  }
} else {
  add_skip("Ferutinin robustness", "Metabolomics block unavailable.")
}
```

# Cross-modal correlation diagnostics

```{r correlation-diagnostics}


## ============================================================
## Cross-modal correlation diagnostics — defensively typed
## ============================================================

if (requireNamespace("conflicted", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressMessages({
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("fixed",  "stringr", quiet = TRUE)
  })
}

.NA_TOKENS_CORR <- c("", " ", ".", "NA", "N/A", "n/a", "#N/A", "#NA",
                     "NaN", "null", "NULL", "-", "--")
.coerce_numeric_strict <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)); x[x %in% .NA_TOKENS_CORR] <- NA_character_
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

## Resolve a feature name to its actual column in `mat`, robust to spaces,
## case, and make.names() normalization. Returns NA_character_ if not found.
.resolve_feature <- function(mat, feat) {
  if (is.null(mat) || is.null(feat) || is.na(feat)) return(NA_character_)
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  if (feat %in% cols) return(feat)
  hit <- which(tolower(trimws(cols)) == tolower(trimws(feat)))
  if (length(hit)) return(cols[hit[1]])
  hit2 <- which(make.names(cols) == make.names(feat))
  if (length(hit2)) return(cols[hit2[1]])
  NA_character_
}

## Resolve a block name to the actual key in `blocks`, robust to case and
## simple aliases. Returns NA_character_ if not found.
.resolve_block <- function(blocks, b) {
  if (is.null(b) || is.na(b)) return(NA_character_)
  bn <- names(blocks)
  if (b %in% bn) return(b)
  hit <- which(tolower(bn) == tolower(b))
  if (length(hit)) return(bn[hit[1]])
  hit2 <- which(startsWith(tolower(bn), tolower(b)) |
                startsWith(tolower(b),  tolower(bn)))
  if (length(hit2)) return(bn[hit2[1]])
  NA_character_
}

## Use the measured_ids attribute we attached earlier; fall back to row coverage.
.measured_rows <- function(mat) {
  ids <- attr(mat, "measured_ids")
  if (is.null(ids)) ids <- rownames(mat)[rowMeans(!is.na(mat)) >= 0.10]
  ids
}

compute_pair_correlations <- function(blocks, meta, pair_table,
                                      max_pairs    = 30,
                                      min_n        = 15,
                                      tie_fallback = TRUE) {

  if (nrow(pair_table) == 0) return(NULL)
  out          <- list()
  not_resolved <- list()
  pair_table   <- pair_table |> dplyr::slice_head(n = max_pairs)

  meta2 <- meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>
    dplyr::select(sample_id, CES_group, Age, Sex, BMI) |>
    dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pair_table))) {
    b1_raw <- pair_table$block1[i];  b2_raw <- pair_table$block2[i]
    f1_raw <- pair_table$from[i];    f2_raw <- pair_table$to[i]

    b1 <- .resolve_block(blocks, b1_raw); b2 <- .resolve_block(blocks, b2_raw)
    if (is.na(b1) || is.na(b2)) {
      not_resolved[[length(not_resolved)+1]] <-
        tibble::tibble(i = i, block1 = b1_raw, block2 = b2_raw,
                       from = f1_raw, to = f2_raw,
                       reason = "block not found in blocks")
      next
    }

    mat1 <- blocks[[b1]]; mat2 <- blocks[[b2]]
    f1 <- .resolve_feature(mat1, f1_raw)
    f2 <- .resolve_feature(mat2, f2_raw)
    if (is.na(f1) || is.na(f2)) {
      not_resolved[[length(not_resolved)+1]] <-
        tibble::tibble(i = i, block1 = b1, block2 = b2,
                       from = f1_raw, to = f2_raw,
                       reason = sprintf("feature not found (f1=%s, f2=%s)",
                                        !is.na(f1), !is.na(f2)))
      next
    }

    ## Restrict to measured rows in EACH block before extracting the feature
    ids1 <- intersect(rownames(mat1), .measured_rows(mat1))
    ids2 <- intersect(rownames(mat2), .measured_rows(mat2))

    d1 <- tibble::tibble(
      sample_id = standardize_id(ids1),
      x         = .coerce_numeric_strict(mat1[ids1, f1])
    )
    d2 <- tibble::tibble(
      sample_id = standardize_id(ids2),
      y         = .coerce_numeric_strict(mat2[ids2, f2])
    )

    dat <- d1 |>
      dplyr::inner_join(d2, by = "sample_id") |>
      dplyr::left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y))

    ## Drop pairs where x or y is effectively constant (would yield rho=0)
    n_unique_x <- length(unique(dat$x))
    n_unique_y <- length(unique(dat$y))
    if (nrow(dat) < min_n || n_unique_x < 3 || n_unique_y < 3) {
      not_resolved[[length(not_resolved)+1]] <-
        tibble::tibble(i = i, block1 = b1, block2 = b2,
                       from = f1, to = f2,
                       reason = sprintf("n=%d, unique x=%d, unique y=%d",
                                        nrow(dat), n_unique_x, n_unique_y))
      next
    }

    ## Pick method: Kendall if heavy ties, else Spearman
    use_method <- "spearman"
    if (tie_fallback &&
        (n_unique_x / nrow(dat) < 0.3 ||
         n_unique_y / nrow(dat) < 0.3)) {
      use_method <- "kendall"
    }

    full_cor <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(dat$x, dat$y, method = use_method))

    by_group <- dat |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(CES_group)) |>
      dplyr::group_by(CES_group) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n   = dplyr::n(),
        rho = suppressWarnings(
                stats::cor(x, y, method = use_method, use = "complete.obs")),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(rho = ifelse(n < 5, NA_real_, rho))

    ## Adjusted residual correlation: regress out CES_group + Age + Sex
    dat_adj <- dat |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(CES_group), !is.na(Age), !is.na(Sex))
    adj_rho <- NA_real_; adj_p <- NA_real_
    if (nrow(dat_adj) >= 20) {
      adj_rho <- tryCatch({
        fx <- stats::lm(x ~ CES_group + Age + Sex, data = dat_adj,
                        na.action = stats::na.exclude)
        fy <- stats::lm(y ~ CES_group + Age + Sex, data = dat_adj,
                        na.action = stats::na.exclude)
        rx <- stats::residuals(fx); ry <- stats::residuals(fy)
        adj_test <- suppressWarnings(
          stats::cor.test(rx, ry, method = use_method))
        adj_p <<- adj_test$p.value
        unname(adj_test$estimate)
      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    }

    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- list(
      summary = tibble::tibble(
        pair_id           = i,
        block1            = b1, feature1 = f1,
        block2            = b2, feature2 = f2,
        method            = use_method,
        n                 = nrow(dat),
        n_unique_x        = n_unique_x,
        n_unique_y        = n_unique_y,
        full_rho          = unname(full_cor$estimate),
        full_p            = full_cor$p.value,
        ces_adjusted_rho  = adj_rho,
        ces_adjusted_p    = adj_p
      ),
      by_group = by_group,
      data     = dat
    )
  }

  list(
    pairs        = out,
    not_resolved = if (length(not_resolved))
                     dplyr::bind_rows(not_resolved) else tibble::tibble()
  )
}

## ---- driver ------------------------------------------------------------
if (length(blocks) > 0 &&
    all(c("from", "to", "block1", "block2") %in% names(table_s4))) {

  pairs_for_diagnostics <- table_s4 |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(Spearman_cor_value)))

  cd  <- compute_pair_correlations(blocks, phenotype,
                                   pairs_for_diagnostics,
                                   max_pairs = 50)
  corr_diag <- cd$pairs

  if (length(corr_diag) > 0) {
    corr_summary  <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(corr_diag, `[[`, "summary"))
    corr_by_group <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      purrr::imap(corr_diag,
                  ~ dplyr::mutate(.x$by_group, pair_id = .x$summary$pair_id))
    )

    save_table(
      list(
        summary       = corr_summary,
        by_group      = corr_by_group,
        not_resolved  = cd$not_resolved
      ),
      "08_cross_modal_correlation_diagnostics.xlsx"
    )

    ## Plot first 6 truly informative relationships
    plot_pairs <- corr_diag[seq_len(min(6, length(corr_diag)))]
    plot_list <- lapply(plot_pairs, function(obj) {
      dat <- obj$data |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(CES_group))
      sm  <- obj$summary
      grp_ok <- dat |>
        dplyr::count(CES_group) |>
        dplyr::filter(n >= 3) |>
        dplyr::pull(CES_group)
      dat <- dat |> dplyr::filter(CES_group %in% grp_ok)

      ggplot2::ggplot(dat,
                      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, color = CES_group)) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
        ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = paste0(sm$block1, " vs ", sm$block2),
          subtitle = sprintf(
            "%s / %s; %s rho full=%.2f, adj=%.2f; n=%d",
            stringr::str_trunc(sm$feature1, 30),
            stringr::str_trunc(sm$feature2, 30),
            sm$method, sm$full_rho, sm$ces_adjusted_rho, sm$n
          ),
          x = sm$feature1, y = sm$feature2
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_bw() +
        ggplot2::theme(axis.title    = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
                       plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8))
    })

    p_corr <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)
    save_plot(p_corr, "S_cross_modal_full_vs_group_diagnostics.png",
              width = 12, height = 10)

    if (nrow(cd$not_resolved))
      message(sprintf("[corr diag] %d/%d input pairs unresolved -- see not_resolved sheet",
                      nrow(cd$not_resolved), nrow(pairs_for_diagnostics)))

    corr_summary |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(full_rho))) |>
      utils::head(10)

  } else {
    add_skip("Cross-modal correlation diagnostics",
             "No Table S4 pair could be resolved to actual block/feature names.")
  }
} else {
  add_skip("Cross-modal correlation diagnostics",
           "Requires blocks plus Table S4 from Supplemental_Data.xlsx.")
}


```

# sPLS-DA / DIABLO robustness, permutation, and feature stability

The reviewers flagged the high AUC values as potential overfitting. This section should be the basis for the revised response. It intentionally separates:

- feature selection/tuning,
- held-out performance estimation,
- permutation testing,
- and selected-feature stability.

For time, set `params$run_heavy_models: false` while drafting. Set to `true` for the final revision run.

```{r splsda-robustness-functions}
## ============================================================
## sPLS-DA / DIABLO robustness suite -- final hardened version
## ============================================================

if (requireNamespace("conflicted", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressMessages({
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr",   quiet = TRUE)
    conflicted::conflict_prefer("fixed",  "stringr", quiet = TRUE)
  })
}

DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS <- c("low_CES", "high_CES")
DEFAULT_POSITIVE   <- "high_CES"

## ---------- Helpers -----------------------------------------------------

.zscore_train_apply <- function(m_train, m_test) {
  mu  <- colMeans(m_train, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv <- matrixStats::colSds(as.matrix(m_train), na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv[!is.finite(sdv) | sdv == 0] <- 1
  list(
    train = sweep(sweep(m_train, 2, mu,  "-"), 2, sdv, "/"),
    test  = sweep(sweep(m_test,  2, mu,  "-"), 2, sdv, "/"),
    mu = mu, sdv = sdv
  )
}

.median_impute_per_block <- function(m_train, m_test) {
  med <- matrixStats::colMedians(as.matrix(m_train), na.rm = TRUE)
  med[!is.finite(med)] <- 0
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(m_train))) {
    if (anyNA(m_train[, j])) m_train[is.na(m_train[, j]), j] <- med[j]
    if (anyNA(m_test [, j])) m_test [is.na(m_test [, j]), j] <- med[j]
  }
  list(train = m_train, test = m_test)
}

.filter_features_train <- function(m_train, min_nonNA_frac = 0.5,
                                   min_unique = 3) {
  n  <- nrow(m_train)
  ok <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(m_train)), function(j) {
    v <- m_train[, j]
    nz_var  <- isTRUE(stats::var(v, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
    has_obs <- sum(!is.na(v)) >= max(10, floor(min_nonNA_frac * n))
    has_var <- length(unique(stats::na.omit(v))) >= min_unique
    nz_var && has_obs && has_var
  }, logical(1))
  ok
}

prepare_diablo_data <- function(blocks, meta,
                                selected_blocks = c("Microbiome",
                                                    "Brain_RSPW_functional"),
                                group_col   = "CES_group",
                                ces_levels  = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS) {

  missing_blocks <- setdiff(selected_blocks, names(blocks))
  if (length(missing_blocks))
    stop("Missing selected blocks: ", paste(missing_blocks, collapse = ", "))

  measured_per_block <- lapply(blocks[selected_blocks], function(m) {
    ids <- attr(m, "measured_ids")
    if (is.null(ids)) ids <- rownames(m)[rowMeans(!is.na(m)) >= 0.10]
    ids
  })
  ids <- Reduce(intersect, measured_per_block)

  meta2 <- meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>
    dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% ids,
                  !is.na(.data[[group_col]]),
                  as.character(.data[[group_col]]) %in% ces_levels) |>
    dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  ids <- intersect(ids, meta2$sample_id)
  if (length(ids) < 20)
    stop("Fewer than 20 samples present in ALL selected blocks with a valid group label.")

  X <- lapply(blocks[selected_blocks], function(m) {
    as.matrix(m[ids, , drop = FALSE])    # raw; impute+scale inside folds
  })
  Y <- factor(meta2[[group_col]][match(ids, meta2$sample_id)],
              levels = ces_levels)

  list(X = X, Y = Y, ids = ids,
       meta = meta2[match(ids, meta2$sample_id), ])
}

## ---- Continuous score (probability-like) extractor --------------------
.extract_test_score <- function(pred, ncomp, positive_label, n_expected) {

  ## A) Newer: pred$predict is a 3D array [samples, classes, comp]
  pa <- tryCatch(pred$predict, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(pa) && length(dim(pa)) == 3) {
    cls <- dimnames(pa)[[2]]
    if (!is.null(cls) && positive_label %in% cls &&
        dim(pa)[1] == n_expected) {
      return(as.numeric(pa[, positive_label, ncomp]))
    }
  }
  ## B) Older: pred$predict[[comp]] is a samples x classes matrix
  pl <- tryCatch(pred$predict[[ncomp]], error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(pl) && is.matrix(pl) && positive_label %in% colnames(pl) &&
      nrow(pl) == n_expected) {
    return(as.numeric(pl[, positive_label]))
  }
  ## C) AveragedPredict
  ap <- tryCatch(pred$AveragedPredict, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ap) && length(dim(ap)) == 3) {
    cls <- dimnames(ap)[[2]]
    if (!is.null(cls) && positive_label %in% cls &&
        dim(ap)[1] == n_expected) {
      return(as.numeric(ap[, positive_label, ncomp]))
    }
  }
  ## D) Final fallback: derive 0/1 from the called class (AUC will compress)
  cls_vec <- tryCatch(pred$class$WeightedVote, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(cls_vec) && length(dim(cls_vec)) == 3) {
    dn <- dimnames(cls_vec)[[3]]
    pick <- if (!is.null(dn) && "centroids.dist" %in% dn) "centroids.dist" else dn[1]
    if (!is.null(pick) && dim(cls_vec)[1] == n_expected)
      return(as.numeric(cls_vec[, ncomp, pick] == positive_label))
  }
  rep(NA_real_, n_expected)
}

## ---- Robust pred_class extractor (mixOmics version-tolerant) ----------
.extract_pred_class <- function(pred, ncomp, ces_levels, positive,
                                n_expected, score = NULL) {

  candidates <- list()

  ## 1) Newer: 3D array [samples, comp, dist]
  wv <- tryCatch(pred$class$WeightedVote, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(wv) && length(dim(wv)) == 3 && dim(wv)[1] == n_expected) {
    dn <- dimnames(wv)[[3]]
    pick <- if (!is.null(dn) && "centroids.dist" %in% dn) "centroids.dist" else dn[1]
    if (!is.null(pick)) candidates[[length(candidates)+1]] <- wv[, ncomp, pick]
  }
  ## 2) Older: pred$WeightedVote is a list of dists, each [samples, comp]
  wv2 <- tryCatch(pred$WeightedVote, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(wv2) && is.list(wv2)) {
    pick <- if ("centroids.dist" %in% names(wv2)) "centroids.dist" else names(wv2)[1]
    m <- wv2[[pick]]
    if (!is.null(m) && length(dim(m)) == 2 && nrow(m) == n_expected)
      candidates[[length(candidates)+1]] <- m[, ncomp]
  }
  ## 3) MajorityVote variants
  mv <- tryCatch(pred$MajorityVote, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(mv) && is.list(mv)) {
    pick <- if ("centroids.dist" %in% names(mv)) "centroids.dist" else names(mv)[1]
    m <- mv[[pick]]
    if (!is.null(m) && length(dim(m)) == 2 && nrow(m) == n_expected)
      candidates[[length(candidates)+1]] <- m[, ncomp]
  }
  ## 4) Per-block class calls -> majority vote
  cls_lst <- tryCatch(pred$class, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(cls_lst) && is.list(cls_lst)) {
    per_block <- lapply(cls_lst, function(x) {
      if (length(dim(x)) == 3) x[, ncomp, 1]
      else if (length(dim(x)) == 2) x[, ncomp]
      else if (is.vector(x))      x
      else NULL
    })
    per_block <- per_block[vapply(per_block, function(z)
      !is.null(z) && length(z) == n_expected, logical(1))]
    if (length(per_block)) {
      mat  <- do.call(cbind, per_block)
      vote <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) {
        tab <- sort(table(row), decreasing = TRUE)
        names(tab)[1]
      })
      candidates[[length(candidates)+1]] <- vote
    }
  }

  ## Pick first usable candidate
  for (cand in candidates) {
    if (!is.null(cand) && length(cand) == n_expected && !all(is.na(cand)))
      return(as.character(cand))
  }
  ## Final fallback from continuous score
  if (!is.null(score) && length(score) == n_expected && !all(is.na(score))) {
    return(ifelse(score >= 0.5, positive, setdiff(ces_levels, positive)))
  }
  rep(NA_character_, n_expected)
}

## ---- Metrics ----------------------------------------------------------
calc_binary_metrics <- function(truth, score,
                                positive   = DEFAULT_POSITIVE,
                                ces_levels = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS) {

  truth <- factor(as.character(truth), levels = ces_levels)

  ## Drop NAs in either truth or score before anything else
  keep <- !is.na(truth) & !is.na(score) & is.finite(score)
  truth <- truth[keep]; score <- as.numeric(score[keep])

  if (length(unique(truth)) < 2 || length(score) < 3) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      auc = NA_real_, sensitivity = NA_real_, specificity = NA_real_,
      balanced_accuracy = NA_real_, accuracy = NA_real_,
      threshold = NA_real_,
      n = length(truth), reason = "single-class fold / degenerate score"
    ))
  }

  roc_obj <- tryCatch(
    suppressMessages(pROC::roc(
      response = truth, predictor = score,
      levels = ces_levels, direction = "<", quiet = TRUE
    )),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(roc_obj))
    return(tibble::tibble(
      auc = NA_real_, sensitivity = NA_real_, specificity = NA_real_,
      balanced_accuracy = NA_real_, accuracy = NA_real_,
      threshold = NA_real_,
      n = length(truth), reason = "roc failed"
    ))

  ## Ask pROC for everything we need at the Youden-optimal threshold.
  co <- tryCatch(
    pROC::coords(roc_obj, x = "best", best.method = "youden",
                 ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity",
                         "accuracy"),
                 transpose = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(co) || nrow(co) == 0)
    return(tibble::tibble(
      auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj)),
      sensitivity = NA_real_, specificity = NA_real_,
      balanced_accuracy = NA_real_, accuracy = NA_real_,
      threshold = NA_real_,
      n = length(truth), reason = "coords failed"
    ))
  if (nrow(co) > 1) co <- co[1, , drop = FALSE]

  tibble::tibble(
    auc               = as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj)),
    sensitivity       = as.numeric(co$sensitivity),
    specificity       = as.numeric(co$specificity),
    balanced_accuracy = 0.5 * (as.numeric(co$sensitivity) +
                               as.numeric(co$specificity)),
    accuracy          = as.numeric(co$accuracy),
    threshold         = as.numeric(co$threshold),
    n                 = length(truth),
    reason            = NA_character_
  )
}

## ---------- Repeated outer CV ------------------------------------------

run_repeated_outer_diablo <- function(X, Y, ncomp = 3,
                                      keepX,
                                      holdout_prop = 0.15,    # was n_folds
                                      n_repeats    = 50,
                                      seed         = 1,
                                      ces_levels = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS,
                                      positive   = DEFAULT_POSITIVE,
                                      verbose    = TRUE) {

  if (!requireNamespace("mixOmics", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("mixOmics required.")
  if (holdout_prop <= 0 || holdout_prop >= 0.5)
    stop("holdout_prop must be in (0, 0.5). Use 0.15 for 15%.")

  design <- matrix(0.1, nrow = length(X), ncol = length(X),
                   dimnames = list(names(X), names(X)))
  diag(design) <- 0

  all_preds      <- list()
  feature_counts <- setNames(rep(list(list()), length(X)), names(X))
  cv_runs        <- 0L
  fold_metrics   <- list()

  for (r in seq_len(n_repeats)) {
    set.seed(seed + 1000L * r)

    ## Monte Carlo / repeated holdout: one 85/15 split per repeat
    split <- rsample::initial_split(
      tibble::tibble(idx = seq_along(Y), Y = Y),
      prop   = 1 - holdout_prop,
      strata = Y
    )
    tr <- rsample::training(split)$idx
    te <- rsample::testing (split)$idx

    X_tr <- lapply(X, function(m) m[tr, , drop = FALSE])
    X_te <- lapply(X, function(m) m[te, , drop = FALSE])
    Y_tr <- Y[tr]; Y_te <- Y[te]

    for (bn in names(X_tr)) {
      ok <- .filter_features_train(X_tr[[bn]])
      X_tr[[bn]] <- X_tr[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
      X_te[[bn]] <- X_te[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
      imp <- .median_impute_per_block(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
      X_tr[[bn]] <- imp$train; X_te[[bn]] <- imp$test
      zs <- .zscore_train_apply(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
      X_tr[[bn]] <- zs$train; X_te[[bn]] <- zs$test
    }

    keepX_local <- mapply(function(kv, m) pmin(kv, ncol(m)),
                          keepX[names(X_tr)], X_tr, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

    fit <- tryCatch(
      mixOmics::block.splsda(X = X_tr, Y = Y_tr, ncomp = ncomp,
                             keepX = keepX_local, design = design,
                             near.zero.var = TRUE),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      if (verbose) message(sprintf("[diablo] r=%d fit failed: %s",
                                   r, conditionMessage(fit)))
      next
    }

    pred <- tryCatch(predict(fit, newdata = X_te,
                             dist = "centroids.dist"),
                     error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(pred, "error")) {
      if (verbose) message(sprintf("[diablo] r=%d predict failed: %s",
                                   r, conditionMessage(pred)))
      next
    }

    score <- .extract_test_score(pred, ncomp, positive,
                                 n_expected = length(te))
    pred_class <- .extract_pred_class(
      pred, ncomp, ces_levels, positive,
      n_expected = length(te), score = score
    )

    if (length(pred_class) != length(te) || all(is.na(pred_class))) {
      if (verbose) message(sprintf("[diablo] r=%d pred_class extraction failed; skipping.", r))
      next
    }
    if (length(score) != length(te)) score <- rep(NA_real_, length(te))

    cv_runs <- cv_runs + 1L
    key <- as.character(r)              # one record per repeat now

    for (bn in names(X_tr)) {
      selected <- unique(unlist(lapply(seq_len(ncomp), function(cc) {
        sv <- tryCatch(mixOmics::selectVar(fit, block = bn, comp = cc),
                       error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(sv)) NULL else sv[[bn]]$name
      })))
      feature_counts[[bn]][[key]] <- selected
    }

    all_preds[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
      rep = r, fold = 1L, idx = te,        # fold kept for downstream compat
      truth     = as.character(Y_te),
      predicted = as.character(pred_class),
      score     = as.numeric(score)
    )

    fold_metrics[[key]] <- calc_binary_metrics(
      truth = Y_te, score = score,
      positive = positive, ces_levels = ces_levels
    ) |> dplyr::mutate(rep = r, fold = 1L, .before = 1)
  }

  pred_df <- if (length(all_preds)) dplyr::bind_rows(all_preds) else tibble::tibble()
  metrics_fold <- if (length(fold_metrics)) dplyr::bind_rows(fold_metrics) else tibble::tibble()

  ## With one split per repeat, per-repeat == per-fold; mirror the slot for compat
  metrics_pooled <- metrics_fold

  stability <- purrr::imap_dfr(feature_counts, function(lst, bn) {
    if (!length(lst)) return(tibble::tibble())
    all_sel <- unlist(lst)
    tab <- table(all_sel)
    tibble::tibble(
      block = bn,
      feature = names(tab),
      selected_n   = as.integer(tab),
      selected_pct = 100 * as.integer(tab) / length(lst)
    ) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(selected_pct))
  })

  list(
    predictions   = pred_df,
    metrics_fold  = metrics_fold,
    metrics       = metrics_pooled,
    stability     = stability,
    n_cv_runs     = cv_runs,
    holdout_prop  = holdout_prop
  )
}

## ---------- Permutation -------------------------------------------------

run_permutation_diablo <- function(X, Y, n_perm = 100, ncomp = 3,
                                   keepX,
                                   n_folds = 5, n_repeats_per_perm = 3,
                                   seed = 1,
                                   ces_levels = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS,
                                   positive   = DEFAULT_POSITIVE) {

  out <- vector("list", n_perm)
  for (p in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    set.seed(seed + p)
    Y_perm <- sample(Y)
    res <- tryCatch(
      run_repeated_outer_diablo(
        X, Y_perm, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX,
        n_folds = n_folds, n_repeats = n_repeats_per_perm,
        seed = seed + p, ces_levels = ces_levels, positive = positive,
        verbose = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("[diablo perm %d] failed: %s", p, conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(res) || !nrow(res$metrics)) next
    out[[p]] <- res$metrics |> dplyr::mutate(permutation = p)
    if (p %% 10 == 0)
      message(sprintf("[diablo perm] %d / %d done", p, n_perm))
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# smoke test:

diablo_data   <- prepare_diablo_data(blocks, phenotype)
  default_keepX <- list(
    Microbiome            = c(70, 40, 50),
    Brain_RSPW_functional = c(50, 10, 10))

test_cv <- run_repeated_outer_diablo(
  diablo_data$X, diablo_data$Y, ncomp = 3, keepX = default_keepX,
  holdout_prop = 0.15, n_repeats = 5, seed = 1, verbose = TRUE)
print(test_cv$metrics_fold)
print(test_cv$n_cv_runs)

## ============================================================
## DIABLO smoke-test plot: held-out samples in latent space
## ============================================================

set.seed(params$seed)

## ---- Single 85/15 split (matches the holdout CV) -----------------------
n  <- length(diablo_data$Y)
tr <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.85 * n))
te <- setdiff(seq_len(n), tr)

X_tr <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) m[tr, , drop = FALSE])
X_te <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) m[te, , drop = FALSE])
Y_tr <- diablo_data$Y[tr]
Y_te <- diablo_data$Y[te]

## ---- Same preprocessing as the CV (train-only fit, applied to test) ----
for (bn in names(X_tr)) {
  ok <- .filter_features_train(X_tr[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- X_tr[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
  X_te[[bn]] <- X_te[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
  imp <- .median_impute_per_block(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- imp$train; X_te[[bn]] <- imp$test
  zs  <- .zscore_train_apply(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- zs$train; X_te[[bn]] <- zs$test
}

design <- matrix(0.1, nrow = length(X_tr), ncol = length(X_tr),
                 dimnames = list(names(X_tr), names(X_tr)))
diag(design) <- 0

keepX_local <- mapply(function(kv, m) pmin(kv, ncol(m)),
                      default_keepX[names(X_tr)], X_tr, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

fit <- mixOmics::block.splsda(X = X_tr, Y = Y_tr, ncomp = 3,
                              keepX = keepX_local, design = design,
                              near.zero.var = TRUE)

pred_te <- predict(fit, newdata = X_te, dist = "centroids.dist")
pred_tr <- predict(fit, newdata = X_tr, dist = "centroids.dist")

## ---- Pull continuous score and latent variables -----------------------
score_te <- .extract_test_score(pred_te, ncomp = 3,
                                positive_label = "high_CES",
                                n_expected = length(te))
score_tr <- .extract_test_score(pred_tr, ncomp = 3,
                                positive_label = "high_CES",
                                n_expected = length(tr))

## In-sample (training) AUC vs held-out AUC, for the response letter
auc_tr <- calc_binary_metrics(Y_tr, score_tr)$auc
auc_te <- calc_binary_metrics(Y_te, score_te)$auc
message(sprintf("[smoke] in-sample AUC = %.3f | held-out AUC = %.3f | gap = %.3f",
                auc_tr, auc_te, auc_tr - auc_te))

## ---- Training-set latent variables (what mixOmics's plotIndiv shows) --
tr_lv <- as.data.frame(fit$variates$Microbiome[, 1:2])
colnames(tr_lv) <- c("comp1", "comp2")
tr_lv$Y    <- Y_tr
tr_lv$set  <- "Training (in-sample)"

## ---- Held-out latent variables (what we actually care about) ----------
## predict() returns latent variables in pred$variates for held-out data
te_lv_mat <- tryCatch(pred_te$variates$Microbiome[, 1:2],
                      error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(te_lv_mat)) {
  ## Fallback in newer mixOmics: pred$variates is a list of test-set scores
  te_lv_mat <- pred_te$variates[["Microbiome"]][, 1:2]
}
te_lv <- as.data.frame(te_lv_mat)
colnames(te_lv) <- c("comp1", "comp2")
te_lv$Y   <- Y_te
te_lv$set <- "Held-out (15%)"

lv_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(tr_lv, te_lv)
lv_all$set <- factor(lv_all$set,
                     levels = c("Training (in-sample)", "Held-out (15%)"))

## ---- Score density per true class (held-out only) ---------------------
score_df <- tibble::tibble(
  score = c(score_tr, score_te),
  Y     = c(as.character(Y_tr), as.character(Y_te)),
  set   = c(rep("Training (in-sample)", length(tr)),
            rep("Held-out (15%)",       length(te)))
)
score_df$set <- factor(score_df$set,
                       levels = c("Training (in-sample)", "Held-out (15%)"))

## ---- Plot --------------------------------------------------------------
p_latent <- ggplot2::ggplot(lv_all,
                            ggplot2::aes(comp1, comp2, color = Y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ set, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = "Microbiome latent space (component 1 vs 2)",
    subtitle = sprintf("In-sample AUC = %.2f vs held-out AUC = %.2f",
                       auc_tr, auc_te),
    x = "Component 1", y = "Component 2", color = "CES"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

p_score <- ggplot2::ggplot(score_df,
                           ggplot2::aes(x = score, fill = Y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(alpha = 0.45) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ set, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "DIABLO predicted score per true class",
    x = "Predicted score (P(high_CES))", y = "Density", fill = "CES"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

p_smoke <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_latent, p_score, ncol = 1)

save_plot(p_smoke, "S_diablo_smoketest_diagnostics.png",
          width = 11, height = 8)
print(p_smoke)
```
