```{r splsda-robustness-run}
## =====================================================================
##  DIABLO robustness suite — repeated 85/15 holdout + permutation null
##
##  Reviewer-grade implementation with full preprocessing inside each
##  training fold (no test-set information used to filter, impute, or
##  scale). Designed to address overfitting concerns raised in review.
##
##  Idempotent: if previous runs produced cached results, they are
##  reused and the run resumes from the last completed permutation.
##  Delete the RDS files in `models/` and `models/perm_checkpoints/`
##  to recompute from scratch.
## =====================================================================

if (all(c("Microbiome", "Brain_RSPW_functional") %in% names(blocks)) &&
    params$run_heavy_models) {

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 0. Paths and configuration
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  out_dir       <- params$output_dir
  models_dir    <- file.path(out_dir, "models")
  perm_ckpt_dir <- file.path(models_dir, "perm_checkpoints")
  dir.create(models_dir,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(perm_ckpt_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  diablo_cv_rds   <- file.path(models_dir, "diablo_repeated_outer_cv.rds")
  diablo_perm_rds <- file.path(models_dir, "diablo_permutation_null.rds")

  HOLDOUT_PROP        <- 0.15   # 85/15 train/test split per repeat
  N_REPEATS_PER_PERM  <- 3      # repeats per permutation in null
  PERM_BATCH_SIZE     <- 50     # checkpoint every N permutations

  diablo_data   <- prepare_diablo_data(blocks, phenotype)
  default_keepX <- list(
    Microbiome            = c(70, 40, 50),
    Brain_RSPW_functional = c(50, 10, 10)
  )

  message(sprintf("[diablo] data: %d samples; blocks: %s",
                  length(diablo_data$Y),
                  paste(sprintf("%s (%d features)", names(diablo_data$X),
                                vapply(diablo_data$X, ncol, integer(1))),
                        collapse = ", ")))

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 1. Patch run_permutation_diablo() to accept holdout_prop and to
  ##    support batched resumption via start_perm. Defined here so the
  ##    block is self-contained and reviewer-readable.
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  run_permutation_diablo <- function(X, Y, n_perm, ncomp,
                                     keepX,
                                     holdout_prop       = 0.15,
                                     n_repeats_per_perm = 3,
                                     seed               = 1,
                                     ces_levels = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS,
                                     positive   = DEFAULT_POSITIVE,
                                     start_perm = 1L,
                                     verbose    = TRUE) {

    stopifnot(start_perm >= 1L, n_perm >= start_perm)
    out <- vector("list", n_perm - start_perm + 1L)
    k   <- 0L
    for (p in seq.int(from = start_perm, to = n_perm)) {
      k <- k + 1L
      set.seed(seed + p)
      Y_perm <- sample(Y)
      res <- tryCatch(
        run_repeated_outer_diablo(
          X, Y_perm, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX,
          holdout_prop = holdout_prop,
          n_repeats    = n_repeats_per_perm,
          seed         = seed + p,
          ces_levels   = ces_levels, positive = positive,
          verbose      = FALSE
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          message(sprintf("[diablo perm %d] failed: %s", p, conditionMessage(e)))
          NULL
        }
      )
      if (is.null(res) || !nrow(res$metrics)) next
      out[[k]] <- res$metrics |> dplyr::mutate(permutation = p)
      if (verbose && (p %% 10L == 0L))
        message(sprintf("[diablo perm] %d / %d done", p, n_perm))
    }
    dplyr::bind_rows(out)
  }

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 2. Observed repeated outer CV
  ##    Reuse cached result if available; otherwise compute and save.
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (file.exists(diablo_cv_rds)) {
    diablo_cv <- readRDS(diablo_cv_rds)
    message(sprintf("[diablo] reusing cached observed-CV results (%d repeats).",
                    diablo_cv$n_cv_runs))
  } else {
    message(sprintf("[diablo] launching observed CV (%d 85/15 repeats)",
                    params$n_cv_repeats))
    diablo_cv <- run_repeated_outer_diablo(
      X            = diablo_data$X,
      Y            = diablo_data$Y,
      ncomp        = 3,
      keepX        = default_keepX,
      holdout_prop = HOLDOUT_PROP,
      n_repeats    = params$n_cv_repeats,
      seed         = params$seed
    )
    saveRDS(diablo_cv, diablo_cv_rds)
  }

  save_table(list(
    predictions  = diablo_cv$predictions,
    metrics      = diablo_cv$metrics,        # per-repeat
    metrics_fold = diablo_cv$metrics_fold,   # per-repeat (same as metrics here)
    stability    = diablo_cv$stability,
    runs_summary = tibble::tibble(n_cv_runs = diablo_cv$n_cv_runs)
  ), "09_diablo_repeated_outer_cv.xlsx")

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 3. Permutation null with checkpoint-based resumption
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  load_perm_checkpoints <- function(ckpt_dir) {
    files <- list.files(ckpt_dir, pattern = "^perm_\\d+_\\d+\\.rds$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
    if (!length(files))
      return(list(done_df = list(), done_max = 0L, n_files = 0L))
    done_df  <- vector("list", length(files))
    done_max <- 0L
    for (i in seq_along(files)) {
      bits  <- regmatches(basename(files[i]),
                          regexec("^perm_(\\d+)_(\\d+)\\.rds$",
                                  basename(files[i])))[[1]]
      done_max  <- max(done_max, as.integer(bits[3]))
      done_df[[i]] <- readRDS(files[i])
    }
    list(done_df = done_df, done_max = done_max, n_files = length(files))
  }

  ck <- load_perm_checkpoints(perm_ckpt_dir)
  if (ck$n_files > 0L)
    message(sprintf("[diablo perm] %d checkpoint(s) found; resuming from perm %d / %d",
                    ck$n_files, ck$done_max + 1L, params$n_permutations))
  else
    message(sprintf("[diablo perm] no checkpoints; starting from perm 1 / %d",
                    params$n_permutations))

  next_start <- ck$done_max + 1L
  done_df    <- ck$done_df

  while (next_start <= params$n_permutations) {
    next_end <- min(next_start + PERM_BATCH_SIZE - 1L, params$n_permutations)
    message(sprintf("[diablo perm] batch perms %d-%d", next_start, next_end))

    batch <- run_permutation_diablo(
      X = diablo_data$X, Y = diablo_data$Y,
      n_perm = next_end, ncomp = 3,
      keepX  = default_keepX,
      holdout_prop       = HOLDOUT_PROP,
      n_repeats_per_perm = N_REPEATS_PER_PERM,
      seed       = params$seed + 10000L,
      start_perm = next_start,
      verbose    = TRUE
    )

    ckpt_file <- file.path(perm_ckpt_dir,
                           sprintf("perm_%05d_%05d.rds", next_start, next_end))
    saveRDS(batch, ckpt_file)
    message(sprintf("[diablo perm] wrote %s (%d rows)",
                    basename(ckpt_file), nrow(batch)))

    done_df[[length(done_df) + 1L]] <- batch
    next_start <- next_end + 1L
  }

  diablo_perm <- if (length(done_df))
    dplyr::bind_rows(done_df) else tibble::tibble()
  saveRDS(diablo_perm, diablo_perm_rds)
  message(sprintf("[diablo perm] complete: %d rows across %d permutations",
                  nrow(diablo_perm),
                  if (nrow(diablo_perm))
                    dplyr::n_distinct(diablo_perm$permutation) else 0L))

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 4. Collapse to one AUC per permutation (correct null granularity)
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  perm_by_perm <- if (nrow(diablo_perm))
    diablo_perm |>
      dplyr::group_by(permutation) |>
      dplyr::summarise(auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    else tibble::tibble(permutation = integer(), auc = numeric())

  save_table(list(per_repeat      = diablo_perm,
                  per_permutation = perm_by_perm),
             "10_diablo_permutation_null.xlsx")

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 5. Robustness summary
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  observed_auc  <- mean(diablo_cv$metrics$auc, na.rm = TRUE)
  permutation_p <- if (nrow(perm_by_perm))
    (1 + sum(perm_by_perm$auc >= observed_auc, na.rm = TRUE)) /
    (1 + nrow(perm_by_perm))
    else NA_real_

  fold_auc <- diablo_cv$metrics_fold$auc
  robustness_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    observed_mean_auc       = observed_auc,
    observed_auc_lcl_fold   = unname(stats::quantile(fold_auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    observed_auc_ucl_fold   = unname(stats::quantile(fold_auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    observed_auc_lcl_repeat = unname(stats::quantile(diablo_cv$metrics$auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    observed_auc_ucl_repeat = unname(stats::quantile(diablo_cv$metrics$auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    permutation_p           = permutation_p,
    n_permutations          = nrow(perm_by_perm),
    n_cv_runs               = diablo_cv$n_cv_runs,
    holdout_prop            = HOLDOUT_PROP
  )
  save_table(robustness_summary, "11_diablo_robustness_summary.xlsx")

  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## 6. Plots
  ## -------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (nrow(perm_by_perm)) {
    null_95 <- unname(stats::quantile(perm_by_perm$auc, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
    p_perm <- ggplot2::ggplot(perm_by_perm, ggplot2::aes(x = auc)) +
      ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey75", color = "white") +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = observed_auc,
                          linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue",
                          linewidth = 1) +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = null_95,
                          linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = null_95, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
                        label = "null 95%", size = 3) +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = observed_auc, y = Inf,
                        hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5,
                        label = sprintf("observed = %.3f", observed_auc),
                        color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title    = "DIABLO permutation null for AUC",
        subtitle = sprintf("Observed mean AUC = %.3f; permutation P = %.3g (n_perm = %d)",
                           observed_auc, permutation_p, nrow(perm_by_perm)),
        x = "Permuted-label AUC (mean per permutation)", y = "Count"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw()
    save_plot(p_perm, "S_diablo_permutation_null_auc.png",
              width = 8, height = 5)
  }

  if (nrow(diablo_cv$stability)) {
    p_stab <- diablo_cv$stability |>
      dplyr::group_by(block) |>
      dplyr::slice_max(selected_pct, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(
        x = selected_pct,
        y = forcats::fct_reorder(feature, selected_pct))) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "grey55") +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ block, scales = "free_y") +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = sprintf("DIABLO feature-selection stability (%d repeats)",
                        diablo_cv$n_cv_runs),
        x = "% of repeats selecting feature", y = NULL
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw()
    save_plot(p_stab, "S_diablo_feature_stability.png",
              width = 10, height = 9)
  }

  robustness_summary

} else {
  if (!params$run_heavy_models)
    add_skip("sPLS-DA robustness/permutation",
             "params$run_heavy_models is FALSE. Set TRUE for final run.")
  if (!all(c("Microbiome", "Brain_RSPW_functional") %in% names(blocks)))
    add_skip("sPLS-DA robustness/permutation",
             "Requires Microbiome and Brain_RSPW_functional blocks.")
}

## ============================================================
## DIABLO full-analysis diagnostic figure (no refitting needed)
## ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("diablo_cv"), exists("diablo_perm"), exists("diablo_data"))

out_dir    <- params$output_dir
figs_dir   <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- 1. Per-repeat held-out AUC distribution --------------------------
fold_auc <- diablo_cv$metrics_fold$auc
auc_mean <- mean(fold_auc, na.rm = TRUE)
auc_lcl  <- stats::quantile(fold_auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
auc_ucl  <- stats::quantile(fold_auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

p_auc <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  tibble::tibble(auc = fold_auc),
  ggplot2::aes(x = "Held-out (15%)", y = auc)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_violin(fill = "grey85", color = NA, width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.06, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
                      color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::annotate("segment",
                    x = 1.35, xend = 1.35, y = auc_lcl, yend = auc_ucl,
                    color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::annotate("point", x = 1.35, y = auc_mean,
                    color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = auc_mean,
                    label = sprintf("mean = %.3f\n95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]",
                                    auc_mean, auc_lcl, auc_ucl),
                    hjust = 0, size = 3.3) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.2, 1.0),
                              breaks = seq(0.2, 1.0, 0.1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = sprintf("Held-out AUC across %d repeats", diablo_cv$n_cv_runs),
    subtitle = "Dashed red line = chance (AUC 0.5)",
    x = NULL, y = "Held-out AUC"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())

## ---- 2. Permutation null vs observed -----------------------------------
perm_by_perm <- diablo_perm |>
  dplyr::group_by(permutation) |>
  dplyr::summarise(auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

null_95 <- stats::quantile(perm_by_perm$auc, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
perm_p  <- (1 + sum(perm_by_perm$auc >= auc_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) /
           (1 + nrow(perm_by_perm))

p_perm <- ggplot2::ggplot(perm_by_perm, ggplot2::aes(x = auc)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey75", color = "white") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = auc_mean,
                      linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue",
                      linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = null_95,
                      linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = auc_mean, y = Inf,
                    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5,
                    label = sprintf("observed\n= %.3f", auc_mean),
                    size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = null_95, y = Inf,
                    hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
                    label = "null 95%", size = 3) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = sprintf("Permutation null (%d permutations)",
                       nrow(perm_by_perm)),
    subtitle = sprintf("permutation P = %.3g", perm_p),
    x = "AUC under permuted labels (mean per permutation)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

## ---- 3. Held-out predicted score distributions per true class ---------
scores <- diablo_cv$predictions |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(score), is.finite(score))

p_scores <- ggplot2::ggplot(scores,
                            ggplot2::aes(x = score, fill = truth)) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(alpha = 0.45) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = "Predicted score by true class (held-out, pooled across repeats)",
    subtitle = "Substantial overlap = limited discrimination",
    x = "Predicted score (P(high_CES))",
    y = "Density", fill = "True CES"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

## ---- 4. Pooled held-out latent space (one representative refit) -------
## We need latent variables, which the predictions table doesn't store.
## Do ONE 85/15 refit and project the held-out samples. This is a
## representative panel only -- the AUC panel above is the actual
## summary across all 50 repeats.
set.seed(params$seed)
n  <- length(diablo_data$Y)
tr <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.85 * n))
te <- setdiff(seq_len(n), tr)

X_tr <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) m[tr, , drop = FALSE])
X_te <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) m[te, , drop = FALSE])
Y_tr <- diablo_data$Y[tr]; Y_te <- diablo_data$Y[te]

for (bn in names(X_tr)) {
  ok <- .filter_features_train(X_tr[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- X_tr[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
  X_te[[bn]] <- X_te[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
  imp <- .median_impute_per_block(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- imp$train; X_te[[bn]] <- imp$test
  zs  <- .zscore_train_apply(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- zs$train; X_te[[bn]] <- zs$test
}
design <- matrix(0.1, length(X_tr), length(X_tr),
                 dimnames = list(names(X_tr), names(X_tr))); diag(design) <- 0
keepX_local <- mapply(function(kv, m) pmin(kv, ncol(m)),
                      default_keepX[names(X_tr)], X_tr, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

fit_rep <- mixOmics::block.splsda(
  X = X_tr, Y = Y_tr, ncomp = 3,
  keepX = keepX_local, design = design, near.zero.var = TRUE
)
pred_rep <- predict(fit_rep, newdata = X_te, dist = "centroids.dist")

tr_lv <- as.data.frame(fit_rep$variates$Microbiome[, 1:2])
colnames(tr_lv) <- c("comp1", "comp2")
tr_lv$Y <- Y_tr; tr_lv$set <- "Training (in-sample)"

te_lv_mat <- tryCatch(pred_rep$variates$Microbiome[, 1:2],
                      error = function(e) pred_rep$variates[["Microbiome"]][, 1:2])
te_lv <- as.data.frame(te_lv_mat)
colnames(te_lv) <- c("comp1", "comp2")
te_lv$Y <- Y_te; te_lv$set <- "Held-out (representative)"

lv_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(tr_lv, te_lv)
lv_all$set <- factor(lv_all$set,
                     levels = c("Training (in-sample)", "Held-out (representative)"))

p_latent <- ggplot2::ggplot(lv_all,
                            ggplot2::aes(comp1, comp2, color = Y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ set, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Microbiome latent space (component 1 vs 2)",
    subtitle = "Training panel is the cosmetic mixOmics plot; held-out panel is the honest one",
    x = "Component 1", y = "Component 2", color = "CES"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

## ---- 5. Feature-selection stability (top 15 per block) ----------------
p_stab <- diablo_cv$stability |>
  dplyr::group_by(block) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(selected_pct, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(
    x = selected_pct,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(feature, selected_pct))) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "grey55") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ block, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = sprintf("Top 15 selected features per block across %d repeats",
                    diablo_cv$n_cv_runs),
    x = "% of repeats selecting feature", y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

## ---- Assemble composite figure ----------------------------------------
top    <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_auc, p_perm, ncol = 2,
                                widths = c(1, 1.4))
middle <- p_latent
bottom <- p_scores

p_composite <- top / middle / bottom +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.1, 0.9)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title    = "DIABLO model robustness: full repeated holdout analysis",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "n = %d samples; 85/15 holdout x %d repeats; mean AUC = %.3f [%.2f, %.2f]; permutation P = %.3g",
      length(diablo_data$Y), diablo_cv$n_cv_runs,
      auc_mean, auc_lcl, auc_ucl, perm_p),
    theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
  )

save_plot(p_composite, "F_diablo_full_diagnostic.png",
          width = 13, height = 14)
save_plot(p_stab,       "S_diablo_stability_full.png",
          width = 10, height = 8)

print(p_composite)

```

# External validation / transferability using the probiotic samples

This section assigns CES/PBS/PopCS to the probiotic dataset using `Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1` and then tests the reduced discovery signature using overlapping microbiome species and RSPW brain-connectivity features.

```{r external-unzip-load}
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
## External validation: stage extra_samples_to_test zip
## -------------------------------------------------------------------

external_base    <- file.path(out_dir, "external_validation")
external_default <- file.path(external_base, "extra_samples_to_test")
dir.create(external_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## 1. Unzip if not already done (idempotent)
zip_path <- input_paths$external_zip
zip_info <- if (file.exists(zip_path)) {
  tibble::tibble(
    zip_file    = basename(zip_path),
    zip_path    = zip_path,
    zip_size_mb = round(file.info(zip_path)$size / 1024^2, 2),
    zip_mtime   = format(file.info(zip_path)$mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  )
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}

if (!dir.exists(external_default) && file.exists(zip_path)) {
  message(sprintf("[external] unzipping %s -> %s",
                  basename(zip_path), external_base))
  unzip_status <- tryCatch(
    utils::unzip(zip_path, exdir = external_base),
    error = function(e) {
      message("[external] unzip error: ", conditionMessage(e))
      character(0)
    }
  )
  message(sprintf("[external] extracted %d entries", length(unzip_status)))
}

## 2. Find the real root.
##    Handles three layouts:
##      a) external_base/extra_samples_to_test/<files>              (flat)
##      b) external_base/extra_samples_to_test/extra_samples.../... (double-nested)
##      c) external_base/<files directly>                           (no wrapper)
.find_external_root <- function(base) {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(base, "extra_samples_to_test", "extra_samples_to_test"),
    file.path(base, "extra_samples_to_test"),
    base
  )
  for (cand in candidates) {
    if (!dir.exists(cand)) next
    real_files <- list.files(cand, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE,
                             all.files = FALSE, no.. = TRUE)
    real_files <- real_files[
      !grepl("(^|/)\\._|(^|/)__MACOSX(/|$)|(^|/)\\.DS_Store$|Thumbs\\.db$",
             real_files)
    ]
    if (length(real_files) > 0) return(cand)
  }
  NA_character_
}

external_root <- .find_external_root(external_base)

## 3. If still nothing, log a skip and bail out cleanly
if (is.na(external_root)) {
  add_skip(
    "External validation staging",
    sprintf("No usable extracted files found under %s. Check that %s exists and is a valid zip.",
            external_base, zip_path)
  )
  external_files <- tibble::tibble(
    path = character(), file = character(), size_mb = numeric(),
    rel_path = character(), mtime = character()
  )
} else {
  message(sprintf("[external] using root: %s", external_root))

  ## 4. Build a clean manifest of real (non-hidden, non-system) files
  all_paths <- list.files(external_root, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE,
                          all.files = FALSE, no.. = TRUE)
  all_paths <- all_paths[
    !grepl("(^|/)\\._|(^|/)__MACOSX(/|$)|(^|/)\\.DS_Store$|Thumbs\\.db$",
           all_paths)
  ]

  external_files <- if (length(all_paths) > 0) {
    fi <- file.info(all_paths)
    tibble::tibble(
      path     = all_paths,
      file     = basename(all_paths),
      size_mb  = round(fi$size / 1024^2, 3),
      rel_path = sub(paste0("^", external_root, "/"), "", all_paths,
                     fixed = FALSE),
      mtime    = format(fi$mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    ) |> dplyr::arrange(rel_path)
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(path = character(), file = character(),
                   size_mb = numeric(), rel_path = character(),
                   mtime = character())
  }

  if (nrow(external_files) == 0) {
    add_skip(
      "External validation staging",
      sprintf("Root %s exists but contains no usable files after filtering hidden/system entries.",
              external_root)
    )
  }
}

## 5. Save manifest + zip provenance (two sheets so reviewers can audit both)
save_table(
  list(file_manifest = external_files, zip_provenance = zip_info),
  "12_external_file_manifest.xlsx"
)

## 6. Status summary (not a full file dump)
message(sprintf("[external] manifest: %d files, %.1f MB total",
                nrow(external_files),
                sum(external_files$size_mb, na.rm = TRUE)))

tibble::tibble(
  status      = if (nrow(external_files) > 0) "OK" else "EMPTY — see skip log",
  root        = ifelse(is.na(external_root), "(none)", external_root),
  n_files     = nrow(external_files),
  total_mb    = round(sum(external_files$size_mb, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
  zip_used    = if (nrow(zip_info) > 0) zip_info$zip_file    else NA_character_,
  zip_size_mb = if (nrow(zip_info) > 0) zip_info$zip_size_mb else NA_real_
)
```

```{r external-helpers}
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
## External validation: file readers, signature loadings, scoring
## -------------------------------------------------------------------

HOST_TAXA_REGEX <- "homo[ _]?sapiens"   # shared with discovery composition plots

## Robust first-match helper. Returns NA_character_ if no match, never errors.
.first_existing <- function(root, pattern) {
  hits <- list.files(root, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE,
                     recursive = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hits[1]
}

read_external_clinical <- function(root, ces_lookup) {
  f <- .first_existing(root, "Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1.*\\.xlsx$")
  if (is.na(f)) {
    add_skip("External clinical read",
             "No Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1 Excel file found in external root.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  ## Find the right sheet defensively
  sheets <- tryCatch(readxl::excel_sheets(f), error = function(e) character(0))
  if (!length(sheets)) {
    add_skip("External clinical read",
             sprintf("Could not read sheet list from %s.", basename(f)))
    return(NULL)
  }
  sheet <- if ("probiotic" %in% tolower(sheets))
    sheets[which(tolower(sheets) == "probiotic")[1]]
    else sheets[1]
  message(sprintf("[external clinical] reading %s, sheet '%s'",
                  basename(f), sheet))

  clinical <- readxl::read_excel(f, sheet = sheet, guess_max = 10000) |>
    as.data.frame()

  ## Verify required columns
  required <- c("NDPNum", "Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1")
  missing  <- setdiff(required, names(clinical))
  if (length(missing)) {
    add_skip("External clinical read",
             sprintf("Missing required column(s) in clinical sheet: %s",
                     paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
    return(NULL)
  }

  clinical$NDPNum            <- as.character(clinical$NDPNum)
  clinical$sample_id_clinical <- standardize_id(clinical$NDPNum)

  ## CES/PBS/PopCS assignment by FIPS lookup
  n_before <- nrow(clinical)
  clinical <- assign_ces_by_fips(clinical, "Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1", ces_lookup)
  n_with_ces <- if ("CES 4.0 Score" %in% names(clinical))
    sum(!is.na(clinical[["CES 4.0 Score"]])) else 0L

  message(sprintf("[external clinical] n=%d rows; %d (%.0f%%) received a CES score by FIPS",
                  n_before, n_with_ces,
                  100 * n_with_ces / max(1, n_before)))

  attr(clinical, "n_with_ces") <- n_with_ces
  attr(clinical, "source_file") <- f
  clinical
}

read_external_microbiome <- function(root,
                                     abundance_col = "Abundance with Children",
                                     exclude_taxa  = HOST_TAXA_REGEX) {

  long_file   <- .first_existing(root, "One Codex Results.*\\.csv$")
  sample_file <- .first_existing(root, "One Codex Sample Sheet.*\\.csv$")

  if (is.na(long_file)) {
    add_skip("External microbiome read",
             "No One Codex long results CSV found.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  long <- readr::read_csv(long_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                          progress = FALSE)
  if (!all(c("Sample Name", "Rank", "Tax Name", abundance_col) %in% names(long))) {
    add_skip("External microbiome read",
             sprintf("Required columns missing in %s. Expected: Sample Name, Rank, Tax Name, %s",
                     basename(long_file), abundance_col))
    return(NULL)
  }
  message(sprintf("[external microbiome] reading %s (%d rows)",
                  basename(long_file), nrow(long)))

  ## Optional baseline filter via sample sheet
  baseline_n <- NA_integer_
  if (!is.na(sample_file)) {
    sample_sheet <- readr::read_csv(sample_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                                    progress = FALSE)
    if (all(c("Name", "Description") %in% names(sample_sheet))) {
      baseline_names <- sample_sheet |>
        dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(tolower(Description),
                                          "baseline")) |>
        dplyr::pull(Name) |> unique()
      if (length(baseline_names) > 0) {
        long <- long |> dplyr::filter(`Sample Name` %in% baseline_names)
        baseline_n <- length(baseline_names)
        message(sprintf("[external microbiome] filtered to %d baseline samples",
                        baseline_n))
      }
    }
  }

  ## Build species-level wide matrix
  n_before <- nrow(long)
  long_species <- long |>
    dplyr::filter(tolower(Rank) == "species") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      feature   = paste("species", `Tax Name`, sep = "_"),
      sample_id = as.character(`Sample Name`),
      value     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[abundance_col]]))
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(tolower(feature),
                                       exclude_taxa)) |>   # drop host
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), value >= 0)

  ## Detect & log duplicates rather than silently summing
  dup_rows <- long_species |>
    dplyr::count(sample_id, feature) |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(dup_rows)) {
    message(sprintf("[external microbiome] %d (sample, taxon) duplicates collapsed by sum",
                    nrow(dup_rows)))
  }

  wide <- long_species |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_id, feature) |>
    dplyr::summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value,
                       values_fill = 0) |>
    as.data.frame()

  ## Per-sample relative-abundance normalization
  sample_ids <- wide$sample_id
  wide$sample_id <- NULL
  mat <- as.matrix(wide)
  row_sums <- rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  zero_rows <- row_sums == 0
  if (any(zero_rows)) {
    message(sprintf("[external microbiome] dropping %d samples with zero retained abundance",
                    sum(zero_rows)))
    mat <- mat[!zero_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    sample_ids <- sample_ids[!zero_rows]
    row_sums   <- row_sums[!zero_rows]
  }
  mat <- sweep(mat, 1, row_sums, "/")

  rownames(mat) <- standardize_id(sample_ids)
  attr(mat, "source_file") <- long_file
  attr(mat, "n_taxa_before_host_removal")  <- dplyr::n_distinct(
    paste("species", long$`Tax Name`, sep = "_")[tolower(long$Rank) == "species"]
  )
  attr(mat, "n_taxa_after_host_removal")   <- ncol(mat)
  attr(mat, "host_taxa_removed_regex")     <- exclude_taxa
  attr(mat, "abundance_column")            <- abundance_col
  message(sprintf("[external microbiome] final matrix: %d samples x %d taxa",
                  nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))
  mat
}

read_external_brain <- function(root,
                                feature_prefixes = c("RS_", "RSPW_")) {
  ## Restrict to baseline first; fall back to any RSPW file with a warning
  f <- .first_existing(root, "RSPW.*Baselines?.*\\.csv$")
  if (is.na(f)) {
    f_any <- .first_existing(root, "RSPW.*\\.csv$")
    if (is.na(f_any)) {
      add_skip("External brain read", "No RSPW brain CSV found.")
      return(NULL)
    }
    message(sprintf("[external brain] no '*Baselines*' CSV found; using %s",
                    basename(f_any)))
    f <- f_any
  } else {
    message(sprintf("[external brain] reading %s", basename(f)))
  }

  brain <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE,
                           progress = FALSE) |> as.data.frame()

  ## ID column detection: prefer common conventional names
  id_candidates <- c("Subject_ID", "SubjectID", "NDPNum", "ID",
                     "sample_id", "Sample")
  id_col <- intersect(id_candidates, names(brain))[1]
  if (is.na(id_col)) {
    add_skip("External brain read",
             sprintf("No recognized ID column in %s. Looked for: %s",
                     basename(f),
                     paste(id_candidates, collapse = ", ")))
    return(NULL)
  }

  ## Feature columns: try each prefix in order
  feature_cols <- character()
  prefix_used  <- NA_character_
  for (pf in feature_prefixes) {
    hits <- names(brain)[stringr::str_detect(names(brain),
                                             paste0("^", pf))]
    if (length(hits)) { feature_cols <- hits; prefix_used <- pf; break }
  }
  if (!length(feature_cols)) {
    add_skip("External brain read",
             sprintf("No feature columns matching any of (%s) in %s",
                     paste(feature_prefixes, collapse = "|"),
                     basename(f)))
    return(NULL)
  }
  message(sprintf("[external brain] %d features with prefix '%s'",
                  length(feature_cols), prefix_used))

  mat <- as.matrix(brain[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE])
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  rownames(mat) <- standardize_id(brain[[id_col]])

  attr(mat, "source_file")    <- f
  attr(mat, "id_column")      <- id_col
  attr(mat, "feature_prefix") <- prefix_used
  mat
}

## Build a loading vector from a discovery loadings table.
## NOTE: by default we use ONLY component 1, because summing comp1+comp2+comp3
## causes opposite-sign loadings to cancel. To weight multiple components,
## pass weight_method = "rms" (root mean square; sign-agnostic) or "sum"
## (the original behavior, kept for reproducibility).
make_loading_vector <- function(tbl, feature_col,
                                comps        = c("comp1", "comp2", "comp3"),
                                weight_method = c("comp1", "rms", "sum"),
                                verbose      = TRUE) {

  weight_method <- match.arg(weight_method)
  if (!feature_col %in% names(tbl))
    stop(sprintf("feature_col '%s' not in loading table.", feature_col))

  comps_present <- intersect(comps, names(tbl))
  if (!length(comps_present))
    stop("No component columns present in loading table.")

  loadings <- tbl |>
    dplyr::rename(feature = dplyr::all_of(feature_col)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(feature), nzchar(as.character(feature))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(comps_present),
                                ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))

  w <- switch(
    weight_method,
    comp1 = {
      if (!"comp1" %in% comps_present)
        stop("weight_method = 'comp1' but comp1 not in loading table.")
      loadings$comp1
    },
    rms = sqrt(rowMeans(as.matrix(loadings[, comps_present, drop = FALSE])^2,
                        na.rm = TRUE)),
    sum = rowSums(as.matrix(loadings[, comps_present, drop = FALSE]),
                  na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  names(w) <- as.character(loadings$feature)

  keep <- is.finite(w) & w != 0
  w <- w[keep]

  if (verbose)
    message(sprintf("[loadings] %s: %d non-zero features using method '%s'",
                    feature_col, length(w), weight_method))

  attr(w, "weight_method")  <- weight_method
  attr(w, "components_used") <- comps_present
  w
}

## Score external samples by a weighted sum of (z-scored) overlapping features.
## - center / scale: optionally pass discovery-set mean/SD per feature for
##   identity-preserving scoring; if NULL, z-score within the external cohort
##   (transferability framing, NOT predictive).
score_signature <- function(mat, weights,
                            center = NULL, scale = NULL,
                            verbose = TRUE) {

  if (is.null(rownames(mat)) || any(rownames(mat) == ""))
    stop("Matrix must have rownames (sample IDs).")

  overlap <- intersect(colnames(mat), names(weights))
  overlap_pct <- 100 * length(overlap) / max(1, length(weights))

  if (length(overlap) == 0) {
    if (verbose)
      message("[score_signature] 0 / ", length(weights),
              " signature features present in external matrix.")
    return(list(
      score        = stats::setNames(rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat)), rownames(mat)),
      overlap      = character(),
      overlap_pct  = 0,
      scoring_mode = "no_overlap"
    ))
  }

  X <- mat[, overlap, drop = FALSE]

  ## Choose scoring mode based on whether discovery-set scale was supplied
  scoring_mode <- if (!is.null(center) && !is.null(scale))
    "discovery_referenced" else "within_cohort"

  if (scoring_mode == "discovery_referenced") {
    c_vec <- center[overlap]; s_vec <- scale[overlap]
    s_vec[!is.finite(s_vec) | s_vec == 0] <- 1
    Xz <- sweep(sweep(X, 2, c_vec, "-"), 2, s_vec, "/")
  } else {
    Xz <- zscore_matrix(X)
  }

  w <- weights[overlap]
  score <- as.numeric(Xz %*% w) / sqrt(sum(w^2))
  names(score) <- rownames(mat)

  if (verbose)
    message(sprintf("[score_signature] %d / %d signature features available (%.1f%%); mode = %s",
                    length(overlap), length(weights), overlap_pct,
                    scoring_mode))

  list(
    score        = score,
    overlap      = overlap,
    overlap_pct  = overlap_pct,
    scoring_mode = scoring_mode
  )
}
```

```{r external-validation-run}
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
## External validation: read data, compute scores, run transfer tests
## -------------------------------------------------------------------

## Settings -- relaxed for the modest external cohort
EXTERNAL_MIN_N         <- 8       # min n for a reportable test
EXTERNAL_BOOT_N        <- 2000    # bootstrap reps for rho CI
EXTERNAL_WEIGHT_METHOD <- "sum"   # matches original manuscript: comp1+comp2+comp3
EXTERNAL_FDR_METHOD    <- "BH"    # Benjamini-Hochberg across all transfer tests

## FIPS normalizer that handles the four common Excel-corruption patterns:
##   1) 12-digit block-group FIPS, leading 0 stripped (11 digits numeric)
##      -> pad to 12, truncate to first 11 (tract)
##   2) 11-digit tract FIPS, leading 0 stripped (10 digits numeric)
##      -> pad to 11
##   3) Already-correct 11-char tract string starting with 0
##   4) Scientific notation in character form
.normalize_fips_strict <- function(x) {
  ## Track whether the input was originally character (already a string)
  ## vs numeric (Excel stripped the leading zero).
  was_numeric <- is.numeric(x)

  if (was_numeric) {
    x <- formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = "")
  } else {
    x <- as.character(x)
  }
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("[,\\s]", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  ## Scientific notation in character form
  has_sci <- grepl("[eE]", x) & !is.na(x)
  if (any(has_sci)) {
    x[has_sci] <- formatC(as.numeric(x[has_sci]),
                          format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = "")
  }

  ## "NA" string from formatC of NA -> real NA
  x[x == "NA"] <- NA_character_

  ## Only pad if the input was numeric (i.e., Excel stripped the leading 0).
  ## Character inputs that already start with "0" are assumed correct.
  if (was_numeric) {
    x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11, paste0("0",  x), x)
    x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 10, paste0("0",  x), x)
    x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & nchar(x) ==  9, paste0("00", x), x)
  } else {
    ## For character input: only pad strings that DON'T start with 0
    needs_pad11 <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11 & !startsWith(x, "0")
    needs_pad10 <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 10 & !startsWith(x, "0")
    x <- ifelse(needs_pad11, paste0("0",  x), x)
    x <- ifelse(needs_pad10, paste0("0",  x), x)
  }

  ## Truncate to first 11 chars (block group -> tract)
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & nchar(x) > 11, substr(x, 1, 11), x)

  ## Final validation: must be 11 digits starting with a valid state code
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11 & grepl("^\\d{11}$", x),
              x, NA_character_)
  x
}

## 1. Read external data ------------------------------------------------
external_clinical <- read_external_clinical(external_root, ces_lookup)
external_micro    <- read_external_microbiome(external_root)
external_brain    <- read_external_brain(external_root)

## 1b. RE-DO CES assignment locally with strict FIPS normalization -----
##     This bypasses any silent failure inside assign_ces_by_fips().
if (!is.null(external_clinical) && !is.null(ces_lookup)) {
  fips_raw <- external_clinical$Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1
  fips_norm <- .normalize_fips_strict(fips_raw)

  message(sprintf("[external FIPS] %d / %d clinical rows have a normalizable 11-digit FIPS",
                  sum(!is.na(fips_norm)), length(fips_norm)))
  if (sum(!is.na(fips_norm)) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("[external FIPS] sample normalized: %s",
                    paste(utils::head(stats::na.omit(fips_norm), 5),
                          collapse = ", ")))
  }

  ## Re-normalize lookup side the same way (idempotent if already 11-digit)
  ces_lookup_clean <- ces_lookup
  ces_lookup_clean$Census_Tract_FIPS <-
    .normalize_fips_strict(ces_lookup$Census_Tract_FIPS)
  ces_lookup_clean <- ces_lookup_clean[!is.na(ces_lookup_clean$Census_Tract_FIPS), ]
  ces_lookup_clean <- ces_lookup_clean[!duplicated(ces_lookup_clean$Census_Tract_FIPS), ]

  external_clinical$Census_Tract_FIPS <- fips_norm

  ## Drop any existing CES columns from previous assign_ces_by_fips() failure
  drop_cols <- intersect(
    c("CES 4.0 Score", "CES 4.0 Percentile",
      "Pollution Burden Score", "Pop. Char. Score", "CES_group"),
    names(external_clinical)
  )
  if (length(drop_cols)) external_clinical[, drop_cols] <- NULL

  score_cols <- intersect(
    c("Census_Tract_FIPS",
      "CES 4.0 Score", "CES 4.0 Percentile",
      "Pollution Burden Score", "Pop. Char. Score"),
    names(ces_lookup_clean)
  )

  external_clinical <- external_clinical |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      ces_lookup_clean |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(score_cols)),
      by = "Census_Tract_FIPS"
    )

  ## Re-create CES_group from the freshly-joined CES 4.0 Score
  if ("CES 4.0 Score" %in% names(external_clinical) &&
      !is.null(params$ces_threshold)) {
    external_clinical$CES_group <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(external_clinical[["CES 4.0 Score"]]) ~ NA_character_,
      external_clinical[["CES 4.0 Score"]] >= params$ces_threshold ~ "high_CES",
      TRUE ~ "low_CES"
    )
  }

  n_ces <- sum(!is.na(external_clinical[["CES 4.0 Score"]]))
  message(sprintf("[external FIPS] %d / %d rows received a CES score after re-join",
                  n_ces, nrow(external_clinical)))
}

## 2. Compact summary of what was loaded --------------------------------

## 4. Build loading vectors from Tables S6/S7 ---------------------------

## 5. Assemble external_scores: clinical + signature scores -------------
external_scores <- NULL
overlap_info    <- list()

if (!is.null(external_clinical)) {
  external_scores <- external_clinical |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_id = standardize_id(NDPNum)) |>

## Coerce the joined-in exposure columns to numeric (Excel can type

## 7. Transfer tests: Spearman rho with bootstrap CI --------------------

.boot_rho_ci <- function(x, y, n_boot = EXTERNAL_BOOT_N, conf = 0.95) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(ok) < EXTERNAL_MIN_N)
    return(c(rho = NA_real_, lcl = NA_real_, ucl = NA_real_))
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]; n <- length(x)
  rhos <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x[idx], y[idx], method = "spearman"))
  })
  rhos <- rhos[is.finite(rhos)]
  q <- stats::quantile(rhos, c((1 - conf) / 2, 1 - (1 - conf) / 2),
                       na.rm = TRUE)
  c(rho = suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x, y, method = "spearman")),
    lcl = unname(q[1]), ucl = unname(q[2]))
}

.test_pair <- function(score, exposure) {
  score    <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(score))
  exposure <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(exposure))
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(score, exposure) &
        is.finite(score) & is.finite(exposure)
  n  <- sum(ok)
  if (n < EXTERNAL_MIN_N)
    return(tibble::tibble(n = n, rho = NA_real_,
                          lcl = NA_real_, ucl = NA_real_,
                          p_value = NA_real_,
                          reason = sprintf("n=%d < %d", n, EXTERNAL_MIN_N)))
  ci <- .boot_rho_ci(score[ok], exposure[ok])
  p  <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      stats::cor.test(score[ok], exposure[ok], method = "spearman")$p.value
    ),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  tibble::tibble(n = n,
                 rho = unname(ci["rho"]),
                 lcl = unname(ci["lcl"]),
                 ucl = unname(ci["ucl"]),
                 p_value = p,
                 reason = NA_character_)
}

external_transfer_tests <- NULL
if (!is.null(external_scores)) {
  set.seed(params$seed)
  sig_cols      <- intersect(c("microbiome_signature_score",
                               "brain_RSPW_signature_score"),
                             names(external_scores))
  exposure_cols <- intersect(c("CES 4.0 Score",
                               "Pollution Burden Score",
                               "Pop. Char. Score"),
                             names(external_scores))

  if (length(sig_cols) && length(exposure_cols)) {
    grid <- expand.grid(signature = sig_cols, exposure = exposure_cols,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    external_transfer_tests <- purrr::pmap_dfr(grid, function(signature, exposure) {
      res <- .test_pair(external_scores[[signature]],
                        external_scores[[exposure]])
      dplyr::mutate(res, signature = signature, exposure = exposure,
                    .before = 1)
    })

    external_transfer_tests <- external_transfer_tests |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_adj_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_value, method = EXTERNAL_FDR_METHOD),
        direction_expected = "positive (higher signature -> higher exposure)",
        direction_observed = dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(rho) ~ NA_character_,
          rho >  0   ~ "positive",
          rho <  0   ~ "negative",
          TRUE       ~ "zero"
        ),
        matches_expectation = !is.na(rho) & rho > 0
      )
  }
}

## 8. Binary group contrast (Wilcoxon) per signature --------------------
external_group_tests <- NULL
if (!is.null(external_scores) && "CES_group" %in% names(external_scores)) {
  sig_cols <- intersect(c("microbiome_signature_score",
                          "brain_RSPW_signature_score"),
                        names(external_scores))
  external_group_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(sig_cols, function(sg) {
    dat <- external_scores |>
      dplyr::select(score = dplyr::all_of(sg), CES_group) |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(CES_group))
    n_low  <- sum(dat$CES_group == "low_CES",  na.rm = TRUE)
    n_high <- sum(dat$CES_group == "high_CES", na.rm = TRUE)
    if (dplyr::n_distinct(dat$CES_group) < 2 ||
        nrow(dat) < EXTERNAL_MIN_N) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        signature = sg, n_total = nrow(dat),
        n_low = n_low, n_high = n_high,
        median_low = NA_real_, median_high = NA_real_,
        wilcox_p = NA_real_,
        reason = sprintf("n=%d / %d groups present",
                         nrow(dat), dplyr::n_distinct(dat$CES_group))
      ))
    }
    wt <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(stats::wilcox.test(score ~ CES_group, data = dat)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    tibble::tibble(
      signature   = sg,
      n_total     = nrow(dat),
      n_low       = n_low,
      n_high      = n_high,
      median_low  = stats::median(dat$score[dat$CES_group == "low_CES"],  na.rm = TRUE),
      median_high = stats::median(dat$score[dat$CES_group == "high_CES"], na.rm = TRUE),
      wilcox_p    = if (is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value,
      reason      = NA_character_
    )
  })
}

## 9. Save everything ---------------------------------------------------
empty_tbl <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) tibble::tibble() else x
if (!is.null(external_scores)) {
  save_table(
    list(
      external_scores       = external_scores,
      transfer_tests        = empty_tbl(external_transfer_tests),
      group_tests           = empty_tbl(external_group_tests),
      signature_overlap     = signature_overlap,
      loading_weights_used  = loading_audit,
      external_data_summary = external_summary,
      join_audit            = external_join_audit
    ),
    "14_external_signature_transferability.xlsx"
  )
}

## 10. Scatter plot: signature score vs CES, colored by CES_group ------
if (!is.null(external_scores)) {
  sig_cols <- intersect(c("microbiome_signature_score",
                          "brain_RSPW_signature_score"),
                        names(external_scores))
  plot_dat <- external_scores |>
    dplyr::select(sample_id, CES_group,
                  dplyr::any_of(c("CES 4.0 Score", sig_cols))) |>

      dplyr::transmute(signature,
                       label = sprintf("n=%d; rho=%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]; p=%.3g; q=%.3g",
                                       n, rho, lcl, ucl, p_value, p_adj_BH))
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(signature = character(), label = character())
  }

  if (nrow(plot_dat) > 0) {
    p_external <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      plot_dat,
      ggplot2::aes(x = `CES 4.0 Score`, y = score, color = CES_group)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +

      ggplot2::labs(
        title    = "External transferability of reduced MAP signature",
        subtitle = sprintf(
          "Weights: %s of comp1+comp2+comp3 from Tables S6/S7; within-cohort z-scoring; bootstrap 95%% CI on rho; BH-adjusted q",
          EXTERNAL_WEIGHT_METHOD),
        x = "CES 4.0 Score (assigned by Demog_ADI_FIPS_2022_1)",
        y = "Reduced signature score (z-scored within external cohort)"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw() +
      ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")
    save_plot(p_external, "S_external_signature_transferability.png",
              width = 10, height = 5)
  }
}
```

```{r output-index}
.classify_file <- function(path) {
  bn  <- basename(path)
  ext <- tools::file_ext(bn)
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^F_",      bn) ~ "main_figure",
    grepl("^S_|^S\\d", bn) ~ "supp_figure",
    ext %in% c("png", "pdf", "jpg", "jpeg", "svg", "tiff") ~ "figure_other",
    ext %in% c("xlsx", "csv", "tsv")                       ~ "table",
    ext %in% c("rds", "RData", "Rdata")                    ~ "rds_model",
    ext %in% c("html", "Rmd", "md")                        ~ "report",
    ext %in% c("rds", "ckpt")                              ~ "checkpoint",
    TRUE                                                   ~ "other"
  )
}

.human_size <- function(bytes) {
  vapply(bytes, function(b) {
    if (is.na(b) || b < 0)        return(NA_character_)
    if (b < 1024)                  sprintf("%d B",   b)
    else if (b < 1024^2)           sprintf("%.1f KB", b / 1024)
    else if (b < 1024^3)           sprintf("%.1f MB", b / 1024^2)
    else                           sprintf("%.2f GB", b / 1024^3)
  }, character(1))
}

all_paths <- list.files(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE,
                        all.files = FALSE, no.. = TRUE)
## Drop hidden/system clutter
all_paths <- all_paths[
  !grepl("(^|/)\\._|(^|/)__MACOSX(/|$)|(^|/)\\.DS_Store$|Thumbs\\.db$",
         all_paths)
]

if (length(all_paths) == 0) {
  output_index <- tibble::tibble(
    rel_path = character(), file = character(), category = character(),
    size_bytes = integer(), size_human = character(), mtime = character()
  )
  message("[output index] no artifacts found under ", out_dir)
} else {
  fi <- file.info(all_paths)
  output_index <- tibble::tibble(
    rel_path   = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(out_dir, mustWork = FALSE), "/"),
                     "", normalizePath(all_paths, mustWork = FALSE),
                     fixed = TRUE),
    file       = basename(all_paths),
    category   = .classify_file(all_paths),
    size_bytes = as.integer(fi$size),
    size_human = .human_size(fi$size),
    mtime      = format(fi$mtime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(category, rel_path)
}

## 3. Category summary for the front of the supplement -----------------
output_summary <- if (nrow(output_index) > 0) {
  output_index |>
    dplyr::group_by(category) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n         = dplyr::n(),
      total_mb  = round(sum(size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024^2, 2),
      latest    = max(mtime, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
} else {
  tibble::tibble(category = character(), n = integer(),
                 total_mb = numeric(), latest = character())
}

## 4. Run metadata for reproducibility ---------------------------------
run_metadata <- tibble::tibble(
  knit_time      = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  r_version      = R.version.string,
  platform       = R.version$platform,
  out_dir        = out_dir,
  base_dir       = if (exists("base_dir")) base_dir else NA_character_,
  seed           = if (!is.null(params$seed)) params$seed else NA_integer_,
  run_heavy      = if (!is.null(params$run_heavy_models))
                     as.character(params$run_heavy_models) else NA_character_,
  n_cv_repeats   = if (!is.null(params$n_cv_repeats))   params$n_cv_repeats   else NA_integer_,
  n_permutations = if (!is.null(params$n_permutations)) params$n_permutations else NA_integer_,
  rmd_file       = tryCatch(knitr::current_input(), error = function(e) NA_character_),
  n_outputs      = nrow(output_index),
  n_skipped      = if (nrow(skip_log) > 0) nrow(skip_log) else 0L
)

## 5. Save the index as a multi-sheet workbook -------------------------
save_table(
  list(
    summary       = output_summary,
    files         = output_index,
    skip_log      = skip_log_out,
    run_metadata  = run_metadata
  ),
  "98_output_index.xlsx"
)

## 6. Console summary (concise; the workbook has the detail) -----------
message(sprintf("[output index] %d files / %.1f MB total / %d skipped step(s)",
                nrow(output_index),
                sum(output_index$size_bytes, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024^2,
                if (nrow(skip_log) > 0) nrow(skip_log) else 0L))
print(output_summary)
print(utils::head(output_index, 25))

if (nrow(skip_log) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("[skip log] %d step(s) skipped — see 99_skip_log_actions_needed.xlsx",
                  nrow(skip_log)))
  print(skip_log_out)
}
```

```{r recommended-mapping}
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
## Audit: which referenced outputs actually exist on disk?
## Catches typos and stale references before submission.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------

.expand_refs <- function(refs) {
  ## Strip parenthetical sheet descriptions, then split on ";"
  cleaned <- gsub("\\([^)]*\\)", "", refs)
  tokens  <- unlist(strsplit(cleaned, ";\\s*"))
  trimws(tokens)
}

mapping_audit <- recommended_mapping |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    referenced_files = purrr::map(new_output, .expand_refs)
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest(referenced_files) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    nzchar(referenced_files),
    grepl("\\.(xlsx|csv|png|pdf|rds)$", referenced_files)
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    category, reviewer,
    referenced_file = referenced_files
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

## Resolve actual on-disk files. Include both basename and path-relative
## checks because some references (e.g., models/diablo_*.rds) have a
## subdirectory prefix.
if (exists("output_index") && nrow(output_index) > 0) {
  all_output_basenames <- output_index$file
  all_output_relpaths  <- output_index$rel_path
} else {
  on_disk <- list.files(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE,
                        all.files = FALSE, no.. = TRUE)
  all_output_basenames <- basename(on_disk)
  all_output_relpaths  <- on_disk
}

mapping_audit <- mapping_audit |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    file_exists = referenced_file %in% all_output_basenames |
                  referenced_file %in% all_output_relpaths |
                  ## Wildcard references (e.g. "S_distribution_<block>.png")
                  grepl("<.+>", referenced_file)
  )

## Wildcard references aren't real filenames; flag them separately
mapping_audit <- mapping_audit |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_wildcard = grepl("<.+>", referenced_file)
  )

missing_files <- mapping_audit |>
  dplyr::filter(!file_exists, !is_wildcard) |>
  dplyr::pull(referenced_file) |>
  unique()

if (length(missing_files)) {
  message(sprintf("[mapping audit] %d referenced file(s) NOT present in %s:",
                  length(missing_files), out_dir))
  for (mf in missing_files) message("  - ", mf)
  message("  (These will be created when their chunks run; rerun this chunk last.)")
} else {
  message("[mapping audit] all non-wildcard referenced output files present.")
}

## -------------------------------------------------------------------

  n_referenced_files = nrow(mapping_audit),
  n_missing          = length(missing_files),
  n_wildcards        = sum(mapping_audit$is_wildcard)
)

    metadata   = mapping_metadata
  ),
  "97_reviewer_output_mapping.xlsx"
)
```

# Session information

```{r session-info}

## =====================================================================
## Reviewer-response figure: original (leaky) vs corrected DIABLO AUC
##
## Re-derives the original AUC under the leaky pipeline (full-sample
## scaling/imputation, 0/1 vote score) and compares against the corrected
## pipeline that's already saved in `diablo_cv` / `diablo_perm`.
##
## Same input data, same model class, same keepX. Only preprocessing
## and scoring change. Fit / predict / class-extraction path is identical.
## =====================================================================

models_dir   <- file.path(out_dir, "models")
diablo_cv    <- readRDS(file.path(models_dir, "diablo_repeated_outer_cv.rds"))
diablo_perm  <- readRDS(file.path(models_dir, "diablo_permutation_null.rds"))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Reconstruct the ORIGINAL leaky pipeline
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

run_leaky_outer_diablo <- function(X, Y, ncomp = 3, keepX,
                                   n_repeats = 50, holdout_prop = 0.15,
                                   seed = 1, verbose = TRUE,
                                   positive   = DEFAULT_POSITIVE,
                                   ces_levels = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS) {

  ## LEAKY STEP 1: filter, impute, and z-score on the FULL dataset
  X_leaky <- lapply(X, function(m) {
    ok <- .filter_features_train(m)             # uses ALL rows
    m  <- m[, ok, drop = FALSE]
    m  <- .median_impute_per_block(m, m)$train  # uses ALL rows
    .zscore_train_apply(m, m)$train             # uses ALL rows
  })

  if (verbose) {
    message(sprintf("[leaky] preprocessed blocks: %s",
                    paste(sprintf("%s(%d)", names(X_leaky),
                                  vapply(X_leaky, ncol, integer(1))),
                          collapse = ", ")))
  }

  design <- matrix(0.1, nrow = length(X), ncol = length(X),
                   dimnames = list(names(X), names(X)))
  diag(design) <- 0

  fold_metrics  <- list()
  fit_failures  <- 0L
  pred_failures <- 0L
  extract_failures <- 0L
  attempted     <- 0L

  for (r in seq_len(n_repeats)) {
    attempted <- attempted + 1L
    set.seed(seed + 1000L * r)
    split <- rsample::initial_split(
      tibble::tibble(idx = seq_along(Y), Y = Y),
      prop = 1 - holdout_prop, strata = Y
    )
    tr <- rsample::training(split)$idx
    te <- rsample::testing (split)$idx

    X_tr <- lapply(X_leaky, function(m) m[tr, , drop = FALSE])
    X_te <- lapply(X_leaky, function(m) m[te, , drop = FALSE])
    Y_tr <- Y[tr]; Y_te <- Y[te]

    keepX_local <- mapply(function(kv, m) pmin(kv, ncol(m)),
                          keepX[names(X_tr)], X_tr, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

    fit <- tryCatch(
      mixOmics::block.splsda(X = X_tr, Y = Y_tr, ncomp = ncomp,
                             keepX = keepX_local, design = design,
                             near.zero.var = TRUE),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      fit_failures <- fit_failures + 1L
      if (verbose && r <= 3)
        message(sprintf("[leaky r=%d] fit error: %s", r, conditionMessage(fit)))
      next
    }

    pred <- tryCatch(
      predict(fit, newdata = X_te, dist = "centroids.dist"),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(pred, "error")) {
      pred_failures <- pred_failures + 1L
      if (verbose && r <= 3)
        message(sprintf("[leaky r=%d] predict error: %s", r,
                        conditionMessage(pred)))
      next
    }

    ## Use the same robust extractor cascade as the corrected pipeline.
    ## Then produce BOTH scores so we can report the "leaky" 0/1 vote AUC
    ## AND (as a sanity check) the probability-based AUC on the same fit.
    score_prob <- .extract_test_score(pred, ncomp, positive,
                                      n_expected = length(te))
    pred_class <- .extract_pred_class(
      pred, ncomp, ces_levels, positive,
      n_expected = length(te), score = score_prob
    )

    if (length(pred_class) != length(te) || all(is.na(pred_class))) {
      extract_failures <- extract_failures + 1L
      if (verbose && r <= 3)
        message(sprintf("[leaky r=%d] class extraction failed (n_expected=%d)",
                        r, length(te)))
      next
    }

    ## LEAKY STEP 2: AUC computed from 0/1 vote score
    score_01 <- as.numeric(pred_class == positive)

    m <- calc_binary_metrics(
      truth = Y_te, score = score_01,
      positive = positive, ces_levels = ces_levels
    )
    if (nrow(m) == 0) next

    fold_metrics[[as.character(r)]] <- m |>
      dplyr::mutate(rep = r, .before = 1)
  }

  out <- if (length(fold_metrics))
    dplyr::bind_rows(fold_metrics) else tibble::tibble()

  attr(out, "attempted")        <- attempted
  attr(out, "fit_failures")     <- fit_failures
  attr(out, "pred_failures")    <- pred_failures
  attr(out, "extract_failures") <- extract_failures

  if (verbose) {
    message(sprintf(
      "[leaky] attempted=%d, completed=%d, fit_fail=%d, pred_fail=%d, extract_fail=%d",
      attempted, nrow(out), fit_failures, pred_failures, extract_failures
    ))
  }
  out
}

## Reconstruct the leaky observed AUC
message("[reviewer figure] reconstructing leaky observed CV...")
diablo_data   <- prepare_diablo_data(blocks, phenotype)
default_keepX <- list(Microbiome            = c(70, 40, 50),
                      Brain_RSPW_functional = c(50, 10, 10))

leaky_cv <- run_leaky_outer_diablo(
  X = diablo_data$X, Y = diablo_data$Y, ncomp = 3,
  keepX = default_keepX,
  holdout_prop = 0.15, n_repeats = params$n_cv_repeats,
  seed = params$seed, verbose = TRUE
)
saveRDS(leaky_cv, file.path(models_dir, "diablo_leaky_observed_cv.rds"))


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1b. Reconstruct the FULLY LEAKY pipeline (tune.block.splsda on full data)
##     This is the strongest form of leakage: features are selected using
##     information from what will later be the "held-out" test folds.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

run_fully_leaky_outer_diablo <- function(X, Y, ncomp = 3,
                                         n_repeats = 50, holdout_prop = 0.15,
                                         seed = 1, verbose = TRUE,
                                         positive   = DEFAULT_POSITIVE,
                                         ces_levels = DEFAULT_CES_LEVELS,
                                         test_keepX = list(
                                           Microbiome            = c(5, 10, 20, 40, 70),
                                           Brain_RSPW_functional = c(5, 10, 20, 40)
                                         )) {

  ## LEAKY STEP 0: full-sample preprocessing (same as run_leaky_outer_diablo)
  X_leaky <- lapply(X, function(m) {
    ok <- .filter_features_train(m)
    m  <- m[, ok, drop = FALSE]
    m  <- .median_impute_per_block(m, m)$train
    .zscore_train_apply(m, m)$train
  })

  design <- matrix(0.1, nrow = length(X), ncol = length(X),
                   dimnames = list(names(X), names(X)))
  diag(design) <- 0

  ## LEAKY STEP 1: tune keepX on the ENTIRE dataset. This is the tuning
  ## leakage: the "optimal" keepX is chosen using information from
  ## samples that will later appear in test folds.
  message("[fully_leaky] tuning keepX on FULL dataset (leaky) ...")
  set.seed(seed)
  tune_res <- tryCatch(
    mixOmics::tune.block.splsda(
      X = X_leaky, Y = Y, ncomp = ncomp,
      test.keepX = test_keepX[names(X_leaky)],
      design = design,
      validation = "Mfold", folds = 5, nrepeat = 2,
      dist = "centroids.dist", progressBar = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (inherits(tune_res, "error")) {
    stop(sprintf("tune.block.splsda failed: %s", conditionMessage(tune_res)))
  }

  ## Extract chosen keepX (mixOmics returns as a list per block per comp)
  tuned_keepX <- tune_res$choice.keepX
  if (verbose) {
    message("[fully_leaky] tuned keepX:")
    for (bn in names(tuned_keepX)) {
      message(sprintf("  %s: [%s]", bn,
                      paste(tuned_keepX[[bn]], collapse = ", ")))
    }
  }

  fold_metrics  <- list()
  fit_failures  <- 0L
  pred_failures <- 0L
  extract_failures <- 0L
  attempted     <- 0L

  for (r in seq_len(n_repeats)) {
    attempted <- attempted + 1L
    set.seed(seed + 1000L * r)
    split <- rsample::initial_split(
      tibble::tibble(idx = seq_along(Y), Y = Y),
      prop = 1 - holdout_prop, strata = Y
    )
    tr <- rsample::training(split)$idx
    te <- rsample::testing (split)$idx

    X_tr <- lapply(X_leaky, function(m) m[tr, , drop = FALSE])
    X_te <- lapply(X_leaky, function(m) m[te, , drop = FALSE])
    Y_tr <- Y[tr]; Y_te <- Y[te]

    ## Cap tuned keepX at available columns (features may differ per split)
    keepX_local <- mapply(function(kv, m) pmin(kv, ncol(m)),
                          tuned_keepX[names(X_tr)], X_tr, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

    fit <- tryCatch(
      mixOmics::block.splsda(X = X_tr, Y = Y_tr, ncomp = ncomp,
                             keepX = keepX_local, design = design,
                             near.zero.var = TRUE),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
      fit_failures <- fit_failures + 1L
      if (verbose && r <= 3)
        message(sprintf("[fully_leaky r=%d] fit error: %s",
                        r, conditionMessage(fit)))
      next
    }

    pred <- tryCatch(
      predict(fit, newdata = X_te, dist = "centroids.dist"),
      error = function(e) e
    )
    if (inherits(pred, "error")) {
      pred_failures <- pred_failures + 1L
      if (verbose && r <= 3)
        message(sprintf("[fully_leaky r=%d] predict error: %s",
                        r, conditionMessage(pred)))
      next
    }

    score_prob <- .extract_test_score(pred, ncomp, positive,
                                      n_expected = length(te))
    pred_class <- .extract_pred_class(
      pred, ncomp, ces_levels, positive,
      n_expected = length(te), score = score_prob
    )
    if (length(pred_class) != length(te) || all(is.na(pred_class))) {
      extract_failures <- extract_failures + 1L
      next
    }

    ## LEAKY: 0/1 vote score for AUC
    score_01 <- as.numeric(pred_class == positive)

    m <- calc_binary_metrics(
      truth = Y_te, score = score_01,
      positive = positive, ces_levels = ces_levels
    )
    if (nrow(m) == 0) next

    fold_metrics[[as.character(r)]] <- m |>
      dplyr::mutate(rep = r, .before = 1)
  }

  out <- if (length(fold_metrics))
    dplyr::bind_rows(fold_metrics) else tibble::tibble()

  attr(out, "attempted")        <- attempted
  attr(out, "fit_failures")     <- fit_failures
  attr(out, "pred_failures")    <- pred_failures
  attr(out, "extract_failures") <- extract_failures
  attr(out, "tuned_keepX")      <- tuned_keepX

  if (verbose) {
    message(sprintf(
      "[fully_leaky] attempted=%d, completed=%d, fit_fail=%d, pred_fail=%d, extract_fail=%d",
      attempted, nrow(out), fit_failures, pred_failures, extract_failures
    ))
  }
  out
}

## Run it (this is slower than the other reconstructions because of tuning)
message("[reviewer figure] reconstructing FULLY leaky observed CV...")
fully_leaky_cv <- run_fully_leaky_outer_diablo(
  X = diablo_data$X, Y = diablo_data$Y, ncomp = 3,
  holdout_prop = 0.15, n_repeats = params$n_cv_repeats,
  seed = params$seed, verbose = TRUE
)
saveRDS(fully_leaky_cv, file.path(models_dir, "diablo_fully_leaky_observed_cv.rds"))

if (!nrow(fully_leaky_cv))
  stop("Fully leaky reconstruction produced 0 folds — see message log.")

fully_leaky_auc <- fully_leaky_cv$auc
message(sprintf("[fully_leaky] %d successful folds; mean AUC = %.3f",
                nrow(fully_leaky_cv), mean(fully_leaky_auc, na.rm = TRUE)))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1c. Compute the in-sample training AUC — this is what the original
##     manuscript reported. Single value; used as an anchor on the figure.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

message("[reviewer figure] computing in-sample training AUC...")

X_full <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) {
  ok <- .filter_features_train(m); m <- m[, ok, drop = FALSE]
  m  <- .median_impute_per_block(m, m)$train
  .zscore_train_apply(m, m)$train
})

design_full <- matrix(0.1, nrow = length(X_full), ncol = length(X_full),
                      dimnames = list(names(X_full), names(X_full)))
diag(design_full) <- 0

tuned_keepX_final <- attr(fully_leaky_cv, "tuned_keepX")

final_fit <- mixOmics::block.splsda(
  X = X_full, Y = diablo_data$Y, ncomp = 3,
  keepX = tuned_keepX_final, design = design_full,
  near.zero.var = TRUE
)

train_pred  <- predict(final_fit, newdata = X_full,
                       dist = "centroids.dist")
train_score <- .extract_test_score(train_pred, ncomp = 3,
                                   positive_label = DEFAULT_POSITIVE,
                                   n_expected = length(diablo_data$Y))
in_sample_auc <- calc_binary_metrics(diablo_data$Y, train_score)$auc

message(sprintf("[reviewer figure] in-sample training AUC = %.3f",
                in_sample_auc))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Sanity-check that the leaky reconstruction actually produced data.
##    If not, degrade gracefully to a 2-panel figure (corrected vs null)
##    with an explanatory note.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!nrow(leaky_cv)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "run_leaky_outer_diablo() produced 0 folds (attempted %d). Check messages above; the leaky vs corrected figure cannot be built.",
    attr(leaky_cv, "attempted") %||% params$n_cv_repeats
  ))
}

leaky_auc <- leaky_cv$auc
if (all(is.na(leaky_auc))) {
  stop("Leaky reconstruction produced only NA AUCs. Check calc_binary_metrics() output.")
}
message(sprintf("[leaky] %d successful folds; mean AUC = %.3f",
                nrow(leaky_cv), mean(leaky_auc, na.rm = TRUE)))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Assemble the comparison data
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

corrected_auc  <- diablo_cv$metrics_fold$auc

perm_by_perm <- diablo_perm |>
  dplyr::group_by(permutation) |>
  dplyr::summarise(auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
null_auc <- perm_by_perm$auc

comparison_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(condition = "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)",
                 auc = in_sample_auc),
  tibble::tibble(condition = "Fully leaky\n(tune + scale + 0/1)",
                 auc = fully_leaky_auc),
  tibble::tibble(condition = "Partial leaky\n(scale + 0/1)",
                 auc = leaky_auc),
  tibble::tibble(condition = "Corrected\n(held-out + prob)",
                 auc = corrected_auc),
  tibble::tibble(condition = "Permutation\nnull",
                 auc = null_auc)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition,
                                   levels = c("In-sample training\n(original manuscript)",
                                              "Fully leaky\n(tune + scale + 0/1)",
                                              "Partial leaky\n(scale + 0/1)",
                                              "Corrected\n(held-out + prob)",
                                              "Permutation\nnull")))

summary_stats <- comparison_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(condition) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n        = sum(!is.na(auc)),
    mean_auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    lcl      = ifelse(dplyr::n() == 1, NA_real_,
                      stats::quantile(auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ucl      = ifelse(dplyr::n() == 1, NA_real_,
                      stats::quantile(auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
print(summary_stats)

fully_leaky_mean <- mean(fully_leaky_auc, na.rm = TRUE)
leaky_mean       <- mean(leaky_auc,     na.rm = TRUE)
corrected_mean   <- mean(corrected_auc, na.rm = TRUE)
inflation_full   <- fully_leaky_mean - corrected_mean
inflation_partial<- leaky_mean       - corrected_mean

corrected_lcl <- stats::quantile(corrected_auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
corrected_ucl <- stats::quantile(corrected_auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
perm_p        <- (1 + sum(perm_by_perm$auc >= corrected_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                 (1 + nrow(perm_by_perm))
null_95       <- stats::quantile(null_auc, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Figure
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

palette <- c(
  "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)" = "#67000D",
  "Fully leaky\n(tune + scale + 0/1)"         = "#B30000",
  "Partial leaky\n(scale + 0/1)"              = "#EF6548",
  "Corrected\n(held-out + prob)"              = "#0570B0",
  "Permutation\nnull"                         = "grey55"
)

train_row  <- comparison_df |>
  dplyr::filter(condition == "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)")
distrib_df <- comparison_df |>
  dplyr::filter(condition != "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)")

summary_distrib <- summary_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(condition != "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)")
summary_train   <- summary_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(condition == "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)")

p_A <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  distrib_df,
  ggplot2::aes(x = condition, y = auc, fill = condition, color = condition)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_violin(alpha = 0.30, color = NA, width = 0.7, trim = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA,
                        fill = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  ## In-sample training — one point, diamond shape
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = train_row,
    ggplot2::aes(x = condition, y = auc),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 18, size = 6, color = "#67000D"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
                      color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ## Callout for the training point
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text", x = 1, y = 0.87,
    label = sprintf("Original manuscript\nreported ~0.9\n(training AUC = %.2f)",
                    in_sample_auc),
    color = "#67000D", size = 2.6, fontface = "italic", hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  ## Distribution labels
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = summary_distrib,
    ggplot2::aes(x = condition, y = 1.02,

    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.5, vjust = 0, color = "grey25"
  ) +
  ## Training label (no CI)
  ggplot2::geom_text(

  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = "A. AUC across model evaluation regimes",

    ),

  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +

p_B <- ggplot2::ggplot(tibble::tibble(auc = null_auc),

save_plot(p_composite, "S_diablo_leaky_vs_corrected.png",

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

leaky_vs_corrected_audit <- summary_stats |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    permutation_p          = ifelse(condition == "Corrected\n(held-out + prob)",
                                    perm_p, NA_real_),
    permutation_n          = nrow(perm_by_perm),
    null_95th_pct          = unname(null_95),
    inflation_vs_corrected = dplyr::case_when(
      condition == "In-sample training\n(original manuscript)"

        ~ fully_leaky_mean - corrected_mean,

        ~ leaky_mean       - corrected_mean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

save_table(

models_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "models")
diablo_cv   <- readRDS(file.path(models_dir, "diablo_repeated_outer_cv.rds"))
diablo_perm <- readRDS(file.path(models_dir, "diablo_permutation_null.rds"))

diablo_data <- prepare_diablo_data(blocks, phenotype)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## Refit final model on full data for STRUCTURAL panels (A, B, D)
## Note: this is training-set fit; its predictive performance is NOT
## the number we report. Structure/loadings ARE meaningful for hypothesis-
## generation panels.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

X_full <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) {
  ok <- .filter_features_train(m); m <- m[, ok, drop = FALSE]
  m  <- .median_impute_per_block(m, m)$train
  .zscore_train_apply(m, m)$train
})
design_full <- matrix(0.1, length(X_full), length(X_full),
                      dimnames = list(names(X_full), names(X_full)))
diag(design_full) <- 0

## Use the tuned keepX from the fully-leaky reconstruction (this is what
## the original manuscript's `list.keepX` would have chosen)
tuned_keepX <- if (exists("fully_leaky_cv")) {
  attr(fully_leaky_cv, "tuned_keepX")
} else {
  list(Microbiome            = c(70, 40, 50),
       Brain_RSPW_functional = c(50, 10, 10))
}
final_fit <- mixOmics::block.splsda(
  X = X_full, Y = diablo_data$Y, ncomp = 3,
  keepX = tuned_keepX, design = design_full,
  near.zero.var = TRUE
)

  )
})

comp_r <- comp_concordance |>

  dplyr::summarise(r = round(stats::cor(micro, brain), 2),
                   .groups = "drop")

p_B <- ggplot2::ggplot(comp_concordance,
                      ggplot2::aes(x = micro, y = brain,

  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ component, nrow = 1) +

                                          high_CES = "#2171B5")) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "B. Cross-block latent concordance",

    x = "Microbiome component score",
    y = "Brain RSPW component score", color = "CES"

  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
```
