```{r session-info}
                 strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey95"))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## PANEL C: HELD-OUT sample projections
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## Do a single representative 85/15 fit and project held-out samples
set.seed(params$seed)
n  <- length(diablo_data$Y)
tr <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.85 * n))
te <- setdiff(seq_len(n), tr)

X_tr <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) m[tr, , drop = FALSE])
X_te <- lapply(diablo_data$X, function(m) m[te, , drop = FALSE])
Y_tr <- diablo_data$Y[tr]; Y_te <- diablo_data$Y[te]

for (bn in names(X_tr)) {
  ok <- .filter_features_train(X_tr[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- X_tr[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
  X_te[[bn]] <- X_te[[bn]][, ok, drop = FALSE]
  imp <- .median_impute_per_block(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- imp$train; X_te[[bn]] <- imp$test
  zs <- .zscore_train_apply(X_tr[[bn]], X_te[[bn]])
  X_tr[[bn]] <- zs$train; X_te[[bn]] <- zs$test
}
design <- matrix(0.1, 2, 2, dimnames = list(names(X_tr), names(X_tr))); diag(design) <- 0
keepX_local <- mapply(function(kv, m) pmin(kv, ncol(m)),
                      tuned_keepX[names(X_tr)], X_tr, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

fit_rep <- mixOmics::block.splsda(X_tr, Y_tr, ncomp = 3,
                                  keepX = keepX_local, design = design,
                                  near.zero.var = TRUE)
pred_rep <- predict(fit_rep, newdata = X_te, dist = "centroids.dist")

held_out_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    block = "Microbiome",
    comp1 = pred_rep$variates$Microbiome[, 1],
    comp2 = pred_rep$variates$Microbiome[, 2],
    CES_group = Y_te
  ),
  tibble::tibble(
    block = "Brain RSPW",
    comp1 = pred_rep$variates$Brain_RSPW_functional[, 1],
    comp2 = pred_rep$variates$Brain_RSPW_functional[, 2],
    CES_group = Y_te
  )
)

p_C <- ggplot2::ggplot(held_out_data,
                      ggplot2::aes(x = comp1, y = comp2,
                                   color = CES_group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ block, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(low_CES = "#F16913",
                                          high_CES = "#2171B5")) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "C. Held-out sample projections",
    subtitle = sprintf("Representative 85/15 split (n_test = %d); model fit on training data only",
                       length(te)),
    x = "Component 1", y = "Component 2", color = "CES"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                 strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey95"))

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## PANEL E: HELD-OUT ROC curves with 95% CI band across repeats
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## Pool held-out predictions across all 50 repeats. Compute the mean ROC
## curve with a per-threshold CI band from the 50 individual ROCs.

if (!requireNamespace("pROC", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("pROC")

roc_data <- diablo_cv$predictions |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(score), is.finite(score))

per_repeat_rocs <- roc_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(rep) |>
  dplyr::group_split() |>
  purrr::map(~ suppressMessages(pROC::roc(
    response  = factor(.x$truth,
                       levels = c("low_CES", "high_CES")),
    predictor = as.numeric(.x$score),
    levels    = c("low_CES", "high_CES"),
    direction = "<", quiet = TRUE
  )))

## Interpolate each ROC onto a common FPR grid
fpr_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 101)
tpr_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(per_repeat_rocs, function(r) {
  stats::approx(x = rev(1 - r$specificities),
                y = rev(r$sensitivities),
                xout = fpr_grid, rule = 2)$y
}))
roc_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  fpr        = fpr_grid,
  tpr_median = apply(tpr_matrix, 1, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE),
  tpr_lcl    = apply(tpr_matrix, 1, stats::quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  tpr_ucl    = apply(tpr_matrix, 1, stats::quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
)

fold_auc <- diablo_cv$metrics_fold$auc
auc_mean <- mean(fold_auc, na.rm = TRUE)
auc_lcl  <- stats::quantile(fold_auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
auc_ucl  <- stats::quantile(fold_auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

p_E <- ggplot2::ggplot(roc_summary,
                      ggplot2::aes(x = fpr, y = tpr_median)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = tpr_lcl, ymax = tpr_ucl),
                       fill = "#0570B0", alpha = 0.22) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(color = "#0570B0", linewidth = 0.9) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
                       linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
                       linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.55, y = 0.15,
                    hjust = 0, size = 3.4,
                    label = sprintf("Mean held-out AUC = %.2f\n95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]\n%d repeats × 85/15 holdout",
                                    auc_mean, auc_lcl, auc_ucl,
                                    diablo_cv$n_cv_runs),
                    color = "grey20") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                              breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                              breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "E. Held-out ROC (repeated CV)",
    subtitle = "Median ROC curve with 95% CI band across 50 held-out folds",
    x = "False positive rate", y = "True positive rate"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## PANEL F: Permutation null distribution vs observed
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
perm_by_perm <- diablo_perm |>
  dplyr::group_by(permutation) |>
  dplyr::summarise(auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

perm_p  <- (1 + sum(perm_by_perm$auc >= auc_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) /
           (1 + nrow(perm_by_perm))
null_95 <- stats::quantile(perm_by_perm$auc, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p_F <- ggplot2::ggplot(perm_by_perm,
                      ggplot2::aes(x = auc)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey75", color = "white") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = auc_mean, linetype = "dashed",
                      color = "#0570B0", linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = null_95, linetype = "dotted",
                      color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = auc_mean, y = Inf,
                    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2,
                    color = "#0570B0",
                    label = sprintf("observed = %.2f", auc_mean)) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = null_95, y = Inf,
                    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3,
                    color = "grey40", label = "null 95th") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "F. Permutation null (n = 1000)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Observed AUC at 90th percentile of null; permutation P = %.3f",
                       perm_p),
    x = "Permuted-label AUC", y = "Count"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## Assemble Figure 4
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

## Layout: A takes half width (square), B/C stack on the right of row 1
## Row 2: D (square), E, F equal widths
top_row <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_A, p_B, p_C, ncol = 3,
                                 widths = c(1.1, 1, 1))
bot_row <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_D, p_E, p_F, ncol = 3,
                                 widths = c(1, 1, 1))

fig4 <- top_row / bot_row +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 4. Sparse multi-block integration resolves a modest but reproducible microbiome-brain signature of environmental exposure",
    theme = ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
  )

save_plot(fig4, "F4_multiblock_signature.png",
          width = 15, height = 10)

fig4

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## Save each panel individually as a standalone PNG
## Panels A and D already exist as PNGs (F4A_chord_associations.png,
## F4D_consensus_arrows.png). Save B, C, E, F as ggplot objects.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

save_plot(p_B, "F4B_cross_block_concordance.png",  width = 8, height = 4.5)
save_plot(p_C, "F4C_heldout_sample_projections.png", width = 8, height = 4.5)
save_plot(p_E, "F4E_heldout_ROC.png",              width = 6, height = 5)
save_plot(p_F, "F4F_permutation_null.png",         width = 6, height = 5)

message("[figure 4] individual panels saved: F4A - F4F")

sessionInfo()
```
